title: When and How Simplified Nutrition Labels Improve Fast-Food Choices
affiliations: and Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: When and How Simplified Nutrition Labels Improve Fast-Food Choices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study received ethical approval from INSEAD's IRB.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully acknowledge the financial support of the General Directorate of Health of the French Ministry of Health and Prevention and of INSEAD.

detail.abstract: Simplified nutrition labels, such as Nutri-Score, are increasingly used in grocery stores, but their effects on out-of-home consumption, their psychological mechanisms, and potential moderators remain poorly understood. An initial online experiment showed that Nutri-Score leads fast-food customers to select meals (and especially desserts) of higher nutritional quality by helping them identify the healthiest options, ruling out three other theory-driven potential mechanisms. A field study involving 200,039 fast-food meals replicated the positive effects of Nutri-Score in a middle-class metropolitan area but found that it backfired in a less affluent provincial town. A second online experiment, which recruited a nationally representative sample, replicated the nutritional improvement for middle-class people living in metropolitan areas, but found no effect among those with a lower socioeconomic status living in provincial towns. Nutrition importance was the only one of the nine factors tested that moderated the effects of Nutri-Score and explained dietary differences across these groups.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了简化营养标签（如Nutri-Score）在外出就餐场景中的效果、心理机制和调节因素。研究发现Nutri-Score能帮助都市中产阶级选择更健康的快餐，但在低收入省份城镇却可能产生反效果，这种差异主要受营养重要性认知的调节。
AI.research_question: 简化营养标签（如Nutri-Score）如何影响外出就餐时的食物选择？其心理机制是什么？哪些因素会调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然简化营养标签在超市中日益普及，但其在外出就餐场景中的效果、心理机制和潜在调节因素仍不清楚，需要实证研究来填补这一知识空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者决策理论，探讨简化标签如何通过信息简化机制影响食物选择，同时考虑社会经济地位和地理环境等调节因素。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：1）在线实验检验Nutri-Score的效果和心理机制；2）实地研究分析200,039份快餐订单；3）全国代表性样本在线实验验证调节因素。
AI.findings: 1）Nutri-Score通过帮助识别最健康选项改善食物选择（特别是甜点）；2）在都市中产阶级中效果积极，但在低收入省份城镇可能产生反效果；3）营养重要性是唯一显著调节因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）明确了简化营养标签在外出就餐场景中的心理机制；2）揭示了社会经济地位和地理环境的调节作用；3）识别了营养重要性作为关键调节变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为餐饮业实施营养标签提供针对性建议；2）提示政策制定者需考虑不同人群的差异化反应；3）为健康促进干预提供实证依据。

title: From Prediction to Profit: A Cost-Sensitive Explainable AI Framework for Telecommunications Churn Management

detail.title: From Prediction to Profit: A Cost-Sensitive Explainable AI Framework for Telecommunications Churn Management
detail.abstract: Customer churn poses a critical challenge in the telecommunications industry, where the cost of acquiring new customers significantly exceeds that of retaining existing ones. While machine learning models have achieved high predictive accuracy, state-of-the-art algorithms often suffer from opacity, limiting their adoption in strategic decision-making. This study proposes a cost-sensitive explainable AI framework that integrates Random Forest with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to not only predict churn but also quantify the economic impact of retention strategies. Using the IBM Telco Customer Churn dataset, the proposed model achieves a Recall of 75.1%, prioritizing the identification of at-risk customers. Beyond prediction, our economic utility analysis demonstrates that the proposed framework generates a potential net profit lift of $114,300 compared to mass-marketing strategies. SHAP analysis further reveals that contract type, tenure, and monthly charges are the primary determinants of churn. These findings provide a transferable framework for telecom operators to optimize pricing structures and formulate targeted, profit-maximizing retention campaigns. The source code and dataset are available at: https: //github.com/WangWeiyi-USM/Telecom-Churn-Analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个成本敏感的可解释AI框架，结合随机森林和SHAP方法，不仅预测电信客户流失，还量化保留策略的经济影响，相比大众营销策略可产生114,300美元的潜在净利润提升。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既准确预测电信客户流失，又具有可解释性并能量化经济影响的AI框架？
AI.motivation: 电信行业客户流失是重大挑战，获取新客户的成本远高于保留现有客户。虽然机器学习模型预测准确率高，但最先进的算法往往缺乏透明度，限制了其在战略决策中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本敏感机器学习、可解释人工智能(XAI)、SHapley Additive exPlanations(SHAP)理论、客户流失预测理论
AI.method: 提出成本敏感的可解释AI框架，集成随机森林和SHAP方法，使用IBM电信客户流失数据集进行验证，通过经济效用分析评估框架效果。
AI.findings: 1) 模型召回率达到75.1%，有效识别高风险客户；2) 相比大众营销策略，框架产生114,300美元的潜在净利润提升；3) SHAP分析显示合同类型、客户任期和月费是流失的主要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将成本敏感学习与可解释AI相结合的理论框架；2) 提供量化AI模型经济影响的评估方法；3) 扩展了SHAP在商业决策中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为电信运营商提供可转移的框架，优化定价结构；2) 帮助制定有针对性的利润最大化保留活动；3) 开源代码和数据集促进实践应用。

title: Price Transparency in Healthcare: Understanding the Impacts of the Price Disclosure Policy in Maine
affiliations: and China Europe International Business School

detail.title: Price Transparency in Healthcare: Understanding the Impacts of the Price Disclosure Policy in Maine
detail.abstract: This research investigates the operational and competitive effects of Price Transparency Regulation (PTR) in healthcare through both theoretical and empirical lenses. We leverage the launch of Maine's price transparency website as a natural experiment and construct a Difference-in-Differences model to identify causal effects. Our analysis links patient flow patterns, negotiation dynamics, and revenue management strategies, offering a unique opportunity to unpack the multifaceted impacts of PTR. We quantify three mechanisms. First, PTR reshapes patient flow: With access to price information, patients become more price sensitive and switch to lower-cost providers, explaining nearly half of the observed 2.74-percentage point reduction in average prices. Second, PTR reduces the negotiated claim prices by intensifying market competition (the competition effect) and through its interaction with noncompetitive factors such as provider bargaining power. Competitive factors, particularly insurer size and provider appeal, explain 80.7% of these supply-side reductions, while noncompetitive factors account for the remaining. Third, the benefits are unevenly distributed: Larger insurers capture greater reductions, while providers with strong patient appeal or broad service portfolios preserve pricing leverage. Together, these findings show that PTR reduces costs through both consumer switching and negotiation dynamics but also amplifies existing market imbalances, privileging larger stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论和实证研究，探讨了医疗价格透明度监管(PTR)的运营和竞争效应。利用缅因州价格透明度网站作为自然实验，研究发现PTR通过患者流向改变、市场竞争加剧和谈判动态调整，使平均价格降低2.74个百分点，但利益分配不均，大型保险公司获益更多，加剧了市场不平衡。
AI.research_question: 医疗价格透明度监管(PTR)如何影响医疗市场的运营和竞争动态？具体通过哪些机制影响价格形成和利益分配？
AI.motivation: 医疗成本持续上升，价格透明度政策被广泛视为控制成本的重要手段，但其实际效果和影响机制尚不明确，需要系统研究PTR对患者行为、市场竞争和谈判动态的多方面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学、市场竞争理论和谈判理论，研究PTR如何通过信息不对称减少、消费者选择改变、市场竞争加剧和谈判力量重新分配等机制影响医疗市场。
AI.method: 采用自然实验设计，以缅因州价格透明度网站推出为准实验，构建双重差分模型(Difference-in-Differences)识别因果效应，结合患者流向数据、谈判数据和收入管理策略分析。
AI.findings: 1) PTR使患者价格敏感度提高，转向低成本提供者，解释了近一半的2.74个百分点平均价格下降；2) PTR通过市场竞争效应和非竞争因素(如议价能力)降低协商索赔价格，竞争因素解释了80.7%的供应方降价；3) 利益分配不均，大型保险公司获益更大，而具有强患者吸引力或广泛服务组合的提供者保持定价优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统识别PTR影响医疗市场的三个核心机制；2) 量化竞争与非竞争因素在价格形成中的相对重要性；3) 揭示信息透明度政策如何与现有市场结构相互作用，可能加剧而非缓解市场不平衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供PTR实际效果的证据基础；2) 帮助保险公司和医疗机构理解PTR下的战略调整；3) 指出单纯的价格透明度可能不足以解决医疗成本问题，需要配套措施防止市场力量进一步集中。

title: Inter-hospital ambulance routing in Sri Lanka
affiliations: Shizuoka University, Shizuoka University and Shizuoka University

detail.title: Inter-hospital ambulance routing in Sri Lanka
detail.abstract: In this study, we consider the emergency medical transportation system inSri Lankan health service to obtain an efficient routing schedule for inter-hospital patient transfers. These transfers are categorized into immediatelyincurred transfers and scheduled transfers (STs), where the STs move patientsbetween two hospitals based on the requirements of high-level facilities. Inboth scenarios, medical experts emphasize not exceeding the minimum risktime of each patient. Focusing on the ST scenario, we propose a mixedinteger programming (MIP) model and test it on random instances with upto 25 patients. Computational results show that the MIP fails to obtaina feasible solution within a time limit of 300 seconds. In order to solvereal-world cases with up to 132 patients, we propose heuristic approaches.The first heuristic is a two-phase method incorporating machine learningand a simplified MIP that reduces the feasible region (ML-MIP). The secondheuristic is also a two-phase approach, where patient-hospital assignments aredetermined in the first phase, and the remaining problem is solved as a vehiclerouting problem with time windows (VRP-TW) in the second phase. Thethird heuristic combines a resource-constrained project scheduling problemfor hospital assignments with the VRP-TW solution approach used in thesecond method. Computational experiments demonstrate that the secondand third heuristic approaches significantly outperform the original MIP andML-MIP on all tested instances.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对斯里兰卡医疗系统中的紧急医疗转运问题，开发了混合整数规划模型和三种启发式算法，以优化医院间患者转移的路线规划，确保不超过患者的最小风险时间。
AI.research_question: 如何为斯里兰卡医疗系统中的医院间患者转移（特别是计划性转移）设计高效的路线调度方案，确保不超过患者的最小风险时间？
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡医疗系统中存在紧急医疗转运需求，包括立即发生的转移和计划性转移。医疗专家强调必须确保每个患者的转运时间不超过其最小风险时间，这对路线规划提出了挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数规划（MIP）、车辆路径问题带时间窗（VRP-TW）、资源受限项目调度问题、机器学习在优化问题中的应用。
AI.method: 1. 提出混合整数规划模型并测试（最多25个患者实例）；2. 开发三种启发式方法：ML-MIP（机器学习+简化MIP）、两阶段分配-VRP方法、资源受限调度-VRP方法；3. 在最多132个患者的实例上进行计算实验比较。
AI.findings: 1. MIP模型在300秒时间限制内无法获得可行解；2. 第二和第三种启发式方法在所有测试实例上显著优于原始MIP和ML-MIP方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将医院间患者转移问题形式化为优化模型；2. 提出结合机器学习和简化MIP的新方法；3. 将问题分解为患者-医院分配和VRP-TW子问题的两阶段框架；4. 整合资源受限项目调度和VRP-TW的混合方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为斯里兰卡医疗系统提供了可处理实际规模（最多132个患者）的转运调度解决方案；2. 提出的启发式方法能够确保患者转运不超过最小风险时间；3. 为医疗资源有限的地区提供了实用的紧急医疗转运优化工具。

title: Transaction Fees as Settlement-Priority Prices: A General-Equilibrium Model of Proof-of-Work
affiliations: University of Saskatchewan - Economics

detail.title: Transaction Fees as Settlement-Priority Prices: A General-Equilibrium Model of Proof-of-Work
detail.abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of a proof-of-work cryptocurrency in which stochastic, capacity-constrained settlement and fee-based strict priority generate confirmation delays. Buyers pre-fund payments and fees, jointly choosing liquidity and priority prices. Contestable priority rules out fee mass points, implying a continuous fee distribution and balance dispersion even with homogeneous users. In balanced growth, lower issuance raises expected returns and shifts the fee distribution rightward, unlike partial equilibrium. With endogenous mining, reward composition links fees to security and welfare. Evidence from Bitcoin SegWit, the 2021 China mining shock and difficulty retarget, Bitcoin halvings, and Ethereum Classic fifthenings supports the mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个工作量证明加密货币的一般均衡模型，研究结算延迟、费用优先级和流动性选择如何影响加密货币经济。模型显示，竞争性优先级规则消除了费用集中点，导致连续的费用分布和余额分散。在平衡增长中，较低的发行量会提高预期回报并使费用分布右移。内生挖矿将费用与安全性和福利联系起来。比特币SegWit、2021年中国挖矿冲击、比特币减半等实证证据支持模型机制。
AI.research_question: 在具有工作量证明机制的加密货币中，结算延迟、费用优先级规则和流动性选择如何影响加密货币经济的均衡结果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多从部分均衡角度分析加密货币，缺乏对结算延迟、费用优先级和流动性选择之间相互作用的一般均衡分析。理解这些因素如何影响加密货币经济对于政策制定和系统设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论、工作量证明机制、随机容量约束结算、基于费用的严格优先级、流动性选择理论、竞争性优先级规则
AI.method: 构建一般均衡模型，分析具有随机容量约束结算和费用优先级的工作量证明加密货币系统。模型包括买方预融资、流动性选择、费用分布和内生挖矿决策。使用实证数据（比特币SegWit、2021年中国挖矿冲击、比特币减半、以太坊经典减半）验证模型机制。
AI.findings: 1. 竞争性优先级规则消除了费用集中点，导致连续的费用分布和余额分散，即使用户同质化也是如此。2. 在平衡增长中，较低的发行量会提高预期回报并使费用分布右移，这与部分均衡分析不同。3. 内生挖矿将费用与安全性和福利联系起来。4. 实证证据支持模型预测的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次构建了考虑结算延迟、费用优先级和流动性选择的工作量证明加密货币一般均衡模型。2. 揭示了竞争性优先级规则如何消除费用集中点并导致连续分布。3. 阐明了发行量变化在一般均衡中的不同影响。4. 建立了费用、安全性和福利之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为加密货币系统设计提供了理论指导，特别是关于费用优先级规则和发行政策。2. 帮助政策制定者理解加密货币经济中的均衡动态。3. 为投资者和用户提供了关于流动性管理和费用选择的决策框架。4. 实证分析为实际加密货币事件提供了理论解释。

title: Social, Educational, and Family Determinants of Alcohol Consumption and Academic Performance among Secondary School Students: An Exploratory Data Analysis

detail.title: Social, Educational, and Family Determinants of Alcohol Consumption and Academic Performance among Secondary School Students: An Exploratory Data Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used fully anonymized, publicly available secondary data. No direct contact with participants was involved, and no ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve a clinical trial.

detail.abstract:
Alcohol consumption among adolescents represents an important public health and educational concern, yet its relationship with academic performance is often examined without sufficient consideration of social, family, and lifestyle context. Many existing studies focus on isolated determinants of educational outcomes, which may obscure broader patterns and interaction effects present in real-world student populations. This study presents an exploratory statistical analysis of alcohol consumption and academic performance among secondary school students, emphasizing social and family-related determinants.
The analysis is based on the Student Alcohol Consumption dataset obtained from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, comprising survey data from 1,044 students enrolled in mathematics and Portuguese language courses. The dataset includes information on weekday and weekend alcohol consumption, academic performance indicators, school absences, family relationship quality, parental education, health status, and selected lifestyle characteristics. An exploratory observational design is adopted, combining descriptive statistics, visualization techniques, and multivariate ordinary least squares regression models.
The results reveal non-uniform patterns in alcohol consumption and academic outcomes. Weekend alcohol consumption exhibits stronger associations with lower final grades than weekday consumption, while higher alcohol intake is also linked to increased school absences, which are in turn associated with poorer academic performance. Family relationship quality emerges as an important contextual factor, with stronger family ties corresponding to weaker negative associations between alcohol consumption and academic outcomes. Additional lifestyle factors, including free time after school and frequency of social outings, are associated with higher levels of weekend alcohol consumption.
All findings are interpreted as observational associations rather than causal relationships. The analysis emphasizes transparency regarding data limitations, including self-reported measures, cross-sectional design, and limited explanatory power of the models. By providing a structured and reproducible exploratory assessment of alcohol-related and social factors in secondary education, this study aims to support further hypothesis-driven and longitudinal research on adolescent alcohol use and academic achievement.

AI.tldr: 本研究对中学生饮酒行为与学业表现的关系进行探索性统计分析，发现周末饮酒与较低期末成绩关联更强，饮酒还与缺勤增加相关，而家庭关系质量能缓冲饮酒对学业的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 中学生饮酒行为与学业表现之间的关系如何？社会、家庭和生活方式因素如何影响这种关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往孤立地考察教育结果的决定因素，缺乏对社会、家庭和生活方式背景的综合考虑，可能掩盖了真实学生群体中存在的更广泛模式和交互效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会生态学视角，强调个体行为与社会环境（家庭、学校、同伴）的交互作用；风险与保护因素框架，关注家庭关系质量作为保护性因素的作用。
AI.method: 基于UCI机器学习库的"学生饮酒消费"数据集（1,044名学生），采用探索性观察设计，结合描述性统计、可视化技术和多元普通最小二乘回归模型。
AI.findings: 1) 周末饮酒与较低期末成绩的关联比工作日饮酒更强；2) 较高饮酒量与缺勤增加相关，缺勤又与较差学业表现相关；3) 家庭关系质量是重要情境因素，较强的家庭纽带对应较弱的饮酒-学业负面关联；4) 课后自由时间和社会外出频率与较高周末饮酒水平相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了饮酒行为与学业表现关系的更全面理解，强调情境因素的重要性；2) 阐明了家庭关系作为保护性因素的作用机制；3) 区分了工作日与周末饮酒的不同影响模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为教育工作者和政策制定者提供基于证据的干预方向；2) 强调家庭支持系统在预防青少年饮酒相关问题中的重要性；3) 提供了结构化、可复制的探索性评估框架；4) 为后续假设驱动和纵向研究奠定基础。

title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of the WHO and ACT-A in COVID-19: Institutional Design, State Sovereignty, and the Politics of Global Health Equity
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of the WHO and ACT-A in COVID-19: Institutional Design, State Sovereignty, and the Politics of Global Health Equity
detail.abstract: This paper assesses the effectiveness of the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Access to COVID-19 Tools Accelerator (ACT-A) in responding to the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly with respect to institution-building, state sovereignty, and prioritizing global health equity. While the WHO played a pivotal role in steering scientific research and development, as well as regulatory processes and international cooperation, the effectiveness of ACT-A highlights a paradoxical relationship between scientific capabilities and political power in global health governance. In separating the various institution-building analyses and current assessments concerning the ACT-A initiative, which involves biotools such as the COVID-19 vaccine, this paper contends that the program achieved significant scientific coordination but underperformed in terms of equity and accessibility. While the voluntary and non-mandatory mode of state cooperation, overall funding challenges, and the prevalence of vaccine nationalism significantly impeded the equitable global distribution of the COVID-19 biotools promoted by the initiative, such challenges reveal how state sovereignty can imperil global health initiatives even when backed by scientific capabilities in global health. This paper concludes that the underperformance of the initiative lies less in scientific capabilities and more within specific structural and political parameters. Through the COVID-19 pandemic response effort, it has become clear that the future effectiveness of the global health response to pandemics must address inherent institution-building weaknesses in episodic health response measures such as ACT-A. Such limitations within future global health institution-building reinforce the production of inequalities in future health emergencies.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了WHO和ACT-A在应对COVID-19大流行中的有效性，发现虽然WHO在科研协调方面表现良好，但ACT-A在公平性和可及性方面表现不佳，主要受限于国家主权、自愿合作模式和疫苗民族主义等政治结构因素。
AI.research_question: 世界卫生组织和COVID-19工具获取加速器在应对COVID-19大流行中的有效性如何？特别是在机构建设、国家主权和全球卫生公平优先化方面的表现如何？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行暴露了全球卫生治理体系的弱点，需要评估现有国际机构（如WHO和ACT-A）在应对全球卫生危机中的实际效果，特别是科学能力与政治权力之间的复杂关系如何影响卫生公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球卫生治理理论、机构建设理论、国家主权与全球卫生关系理论、卫生公平理论，以及科学能力与政治权力在危机应对中的相互作用框架。
AI.method: 对WHO和ACT-A的机构建设分析、现状评估和政策分析，重点关注COVID-19疫苗等生物工具的协调、分配和可及性机制。
AI.findings: 1. WHO在科研开发、监管流程和国际合作方面发挥了关键作用；2. ACT-A在科学协调方面取得显著成就，但在公平性和可及性方面表现不佳；3. 自愿合作模式、资金挑战和疫苗民族主义严重阻碍了生物工具的公平分配；4. 国家主权即使有科学能力支持也可能危及全球卫生倡议。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了全球卫生治理中科学能力与政治权力之间的悖论关系，强调了机构建设中的结构性政治参数比科学能力更能决定全球卫生倡议的成功，为理解国家主权如何影响全球卫生公平提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了未来全球卫生机构建设需要解决的根本弱点，特别是应对突发卫生事件的临时性措施（如ACT-A）的制度缺陷，为避免未来卫生紧急情况中不平等现象的再生产提供了政策建议。

title: Protecting the Unbanked: Consumer Rights and Regulatory Gaps in Nigeria's Crypto Ecosystem
affiliations: University of Illinois College of Law

detail.title: Protecting the Unbanked: Consumer Rights and Regulatory Gaps in Nigeria's Crypto Ecosystem
detail.abstract: The unbanked / underbanked customer has often stayed outside the radar until recently, with the innovation in financial services. Particularly, the crypto currency innovation seeped into Nigeria's regulatory cracks but has increasingly come under regulatory scrutiny from the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and the Nigerian Securities Exchange Commission (SEC). While crypto currency poses as an innovation for financial inclusion, the rural and unbanked consumers are still exposed to frauds, scams, data mining and weak mechanisms for redress. This work explores the regulatory landscape in Nigeria with particular focus on the relevant SEC and CBN rules. The work recognizes that, although these measures improve formal oversight they do not yet meet up to global expectations as they fail to articulate robust measures for proactively securing the space. Another concern is the fractured / blurred jurisdictional spheres between the CBN, SEC, the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission FCCPC, and Nigeria Data Protection Commission NDPC with each regulator issuing overlapping regulations and directives. The doctrinal method is the chosen research method for the purpose of synthesising information from various sources of law, regulations, guidelines and circulars, (including those issued by the CBN, SEC, FCCPC, and NDPC). The work also reviews publications by international and relevant local organizations, case law, journals and articles The paper proposes a cross-collaborative regime which should amend and (or) consolidate the existing laws to adopt global best practices for AML, CFT and KYC. This paper concludes by proposing a consumer-rights-first design incorporating technological measures (like escrow and automatic funds reversal) as this is flexible and attaches regulations to the core principle and underlying actions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨尼日利亚加密货币监管现状，分析现有监管框架的不足，提出跨部门协作的监管改革方案，强调以消费者权益为核心的监管设计。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚现有加密货币监管框架如何有效保护无银行账户/银行服务不足的消费者权益，以及如何改进监管体系以应对金融创新带来的挑战？
AI.motivation: 加密货币作为金融包容性创新进入尼日利亚，但农村和无银行账户消费者面临欺诈、数据挖掘和救济机制薄弱等问题。现有监管框架存在重叠和不足，需要系统性改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、监管协调理论、消费者保护理论、金融科技监管理论
AI.method: 采用教义学研究方法，综合分析法律、法规、指南和通告（来自CBN、SEC、FCCPC、NDPC等机构），并审查国际和本地组织出版物、判例法、期刊文章
AI.findings: 1. 现有监管措施虽改善了正式监督，但未达到全球标准；2. CBN、SEC、FCCPC、NDPC等机构存在管辖权重叠和模糊问题；3. 缺乏主动保护空间的强有力措施；4. 消费者保护机制薄弱
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出尼日利亚加密货币监管的跨部门协作理论框架；2. 构建消费者权益优先的监管设计理论；3. 为新兴市场金融科技监管提供理论参考
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议修订/整合现有法律，采用全球最佳实践（AML、CFT、KYC）；2. 提出以消费者权益为核心的技术措施（如托管和自动资金返还）；3. 为监管机构提供具体改革方案

title: Foundational Fictions in AI Governance: Why Useful Untruths Require Structural Honesty

detail.title: Foundational Fictions in AI Governance: Why Useful Untruths Require Structural Honesty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract:
Contemporary AI governance faces a persistent coordination problem. Large-scale systems are deployed under uncertainty across domains where authority, discretion, and harm attribution matter, yet accountability failures recur even where transparency, documentation, and compliance mechanisms are formally present. This paper argues that these failures are not primarily technical or epistemic. They arise from how institutions coordinate action through AI systems whose outputs are treated as decisions without stable responsibility assignment.
The paper analyzes AI deployment as a foundational fiction: a socially constructed coordination device comparable to money or corporate personhood. Such fictions enable collective action by allowing institutions to act as if certain questions are settled. They become pathological, however, when their fictional status is denied at assignment points where authority, responsibility, and liability are allocated. In AI governance, this denial enables predictable accountability escape through layered deployment chains and post-hoc responsibility relocation. 
To address this failure mode, the paper introduces structural honesty as a governance principle, defined narrowly as explicit status acknowledgment at assignment points. Structural honesty does not require increased transparency, interpretability, or alignment. It constrains authorship by preventing institutions from attributing decisions to systems rather than to accountable actors. The paper operationalizes this principle through Spider Vision, a dual-level oversight framework linking technical system monitoring (Primary Vision) with institutional responsibility mapping (Secondary Vision). 
The analysis specifies proof-of-concept interventions, including fiction-status disclaimers, liability reattachment rules, and custodial organizational roles. It proposes falsifiable empirical pilots in healthcare AI and autonomous vehicle deployment, using observable metrics such as Bias Persistence, Accountability Drift, and Trust Erosion. The contribution is diagnostic and operational: a testable framework for governing AI as a coordinating convention without allowing its useful untruths to dissolve accountability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AI治理中的协调问题源于将AI系统视为"基础虚构"，这种虚构在责任分配点被否认时导致问责制失效。论文引入"结构诚实"原则，要求明确承认AI系统的虚构状态，并提出Spider Vision双级监督框架来防止责任逃避。
AI.research_question: 为什么在透明度、文档和合规机制正式存在的情况下，AI治理中的问责制失败仍然反复出现？如何设计治理框架来防止AI部署中的责任逃避？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理面临持续的协调问题，大规模系统在不确定性下部署，即使有正式的透明度、文档和合规机制，问责制失败仍然反复出现。这些失败不是技术或认知问题，而是源于如何通过AI系统协调行动的制度安排。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础虚构理论：将AI部署视为社会构建的协调装置（类似于货币或公司法人人格）；结构诚实原则；Spider Vision双级监督框架；责任分配点理论。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，提出可证伪的实证试点（医疗AI和自动驾驶部署），使用可观察指标如偏见持续性、问责漂移和信任侵蚀。
AI.findings: AI治理中的问责制失败源于将AI系统输出视为决策而不分配稳定责任；当虚构状态在责任分配点被否认时，导致可预测的责任逃避；通过分层部署链和事后责任转移实现问责制逃避。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI部署概念化为"基础虚构"；2. 提出"结构诚实"作为治理原则；3. 开发Spider Vision双级监督框架；4. 提供诊断AI治理协调问题的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 具体干预措施：虚构状态免责声明、责任重新附着规则、保管组织角色；2. 可操作框架：Spider Vision监督系统；3. 实证试点设计：医疗AI和自动驾驶部署；4. 可观察指标：偏见持续性、问责漂移、信任侵蚀。

title: Tone at the Top, Corporate Irresponsibility and The Enron Emails
affiliations: , York University - Schulich School of Business, Schulich School of Business, York University and University of Calgary - Haskayne School of Business

detail.title: Tone at the Top, Corporate Irresponsibility and The Enron Emails

declarations.funderStatement: The authors wish to thank the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council, Canada and the Haskayne School of Business, University of Calgary, Canada for funding this project.

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This study examines whether senior Enron executive emails celebrated, or at least left a space for, corporate irresponsibility. Engaging with prior organizational-focused research, we investigate how corporate emails sent by senior executives help constitute Enron by communicating to employees senior management's stance about important topics and social characters. 

Design/Method/Approach: The study analyzes the 527,356 sentences contained in 144,228 emails sent by Enron senior executives and other employees in the three-year period (1999-2001) before the company's collapse. Sentences are used as the base-level speech unit because we are interested in identifying the tone and emotions expressed about specific topics and stakeholders. Tone is measured using Loughran and McDonald's (2016) financial dictionary approach and emotion is measured using Mohammad and Turney's (2013) NRC word-emotion lexicon. LASSO regressions are used to explore the determinants of senior management tone and emotions. 

Findings: The analysis illustrates that while both senior executives and other employees utilized email to help accomplish task-related activities, they employed different evaluative tones to talk about key topics and stakeholders. Also important is what is left unsaid, with a 'spiral of silence' emanating from senior management that created a space for corporate irresponsibility. 

Originality/Value: Combining advanced computerized textual analysis with qualitative techniques, we analyze a unique dataset to explore micro details involved in using email to communicate a tone at the top. The findings illustrate how what is said or not said by senior management contributes to the constitution of an organization.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析安然公司高管邮件，发现高管通过选择性沉默创造了企业不负责行为的空间，揭示了"高层基调"如何通过语言和非语言沟通塑造组织文化。
AI.research_question: 安然公司高管邮件是否庆祝或为企业不负责行为创造了空间？高管邮件如何通过沟通重要话题和社会角色的立场来构建组织？
AI.motivation: 研究企业沟通如何塑造组织文化和行为，特别是安然公司作为企业丑闻典型案例，其高管邮件如何反映和影响公司文化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织沟通理论、高层基调理论、沉默螺旋理论、企业社会责任理论
AI.method: 分析1999-2001年间安然公司144,228封邮件中的527,356个句子，使用Loughran和McDonald财务词典测量语调，使用NRC词-情感词典测量情感，采用LASSO回归分析高管语调决定因素。
AI.findings: 高管和普通员工使用不同评价语调讨论关键话题和利益相关者；高管存在"沉默螺旋"，通过选择性沉默为企业不负责行为创造空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将沉默螺旋理论应用于组织沟通研究，展示高层基调如何通过语言和非语言沟通共同构建组织；推进企业沟通与组织文化关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者提供警示：选择性沉默可能创造不道德行为的空间；强调高层沟通对组织文化塑造的重要性；为监管机构提供识别潜在企业风险的新视角。

title: Demand Information Sharing in a Green Supply Chain Under Upstream Competition
affiliations: Wuhan University - School of Economics and Management, Wuhan University, Wuhan University and Wuhan University

detail.title: Demand Information Sharing in a Green Supply Chain Under Upstream Competition
detail.abstract: Building a green and sustainable supply chain has been an initiative of leading companies under consumers' prevailing ecological awareness and the government's low carbon subsidy programs. Motivated by the trend that firms are self-incentivized to choose from multiple versions of demand information sharing toolkits provided by retail platforms, we develop a game-theoretic model with two competing manufacturers selling substitutable products through a common retailer, who has a private signal about market demand and decides whether, how much, and to whom to share the demand signal. We examine the incentives of firms to form an information-sharing partnership without or with a side payment contract specifying information fee and accuracy. Our analysis shows that green production technical cost is an important mediator in driving the formation of the information-sharing partnership. Without the side payment contract, as the cost enlarges, the retailer's decision varies from sharing with both, to one, and finally to neither manufacturer, whereas the manufacturers are always better off from information sharing. With the side payment contract, the retailer's asymmetric sharing arrangement only occurs when the cost asymmetry is relatively large. Moreover, we characterize conditions where partial information sharing arises in equilibrium, which requires a moderate cost asymmetry. We also find that information sharing is more likely to happen when the government's low-carbon subsidy or consumers' green preference increases, whereas competition intensity has opposite effects on the incentives of the retailer and the manufacturers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究绿色供应链中，零售商如何选择需求信息共享策略。通过博弈论模型分析，发现绿色生产技术成本是影响信息共享伙伴关系形成的关键中介因素。在没有侧支付合同时，随着成本增加，零售商的共享决策从与两家制造商共享，变为只与一家共享，最后不共享；而制造商总是从信息共享中获益。在有侧支付合同时，只有当成本不对称较大时才会出现不对称共享安排。部分信息共享需要适度的成本不对称。政府低碳补贴或消费者绿色偏好增加会促进信息共享，而竞争强度对零售商和制造商的影响相反。
AI.research_question: 在绿色供应链背景下，当零售商拥有市场需求私有信号时，如何决定是否、与谁、以及以何种方式共享需求信息？绿色生产技术成本如何影响信息共享伙伴关系的形成？
AI.motivation: 在消费者环保意识增强和政府低碳补贴政策的推动下，企业有动力建立绿色可持续供应链。现实中，企业会从零售平台提供的多种需求信息共享工具包中进行选择，这激发了研究企业在绿色供应链中信息共享决策的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型：两个竞争制造商通过共同零售商销售可替代产品；零售商拥有市场需求私有信号；信息共享决策分析；侧支付合同（信息费用和准确性）；绿色生产技术成本作为关键中介变量。
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型，分析两个竞争制造商通过共同零售商销售可替代产品的场景。零售商拥有市场需求私有信号，决定是否、与谁、以及如何共享信息。分析有无侧支付合同（指定信息费用和准确性）两种情况下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1. 绿色生产技术成本是信息共享伙伴关系形成的重要中介因素；2. 无侧支付合同时，随着成本增加，零售商共享决策从与两家共享变为只与一家共享，最后不共享，而制造商总是获益；3. 有侧支付合同时，只有成本不对称较大时才会出现不对称共享安排；4. 部分信息共享需要适度的成本不对称；5. 政府低碳补贴或消费者绿色偏好增加会促进信息共享；6. 竞争强度对零售商和制造商的影响相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将绿色生产技术成本作为信息共享决策的关键中介变量；2. 揭示了信息共享伙伴关系形成的动态机制；3. 提出了部分信息共享均衡的条件；4. 分析了侧支付合同对信息共享安排的影响；5. 整合了政府政策和消费者偏好对信息共享决策的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业制定绿色供应链信息共享策略提供指导；2. 帮助零售商优化信息共享决策以最大化收益；3. 为制造商评估信息共享价值提供参考；4. 为政府制定低碳补贴政策提供理论依据；5. 帮助企业理解竞争环境对信息共享决策的影响。

title: Behavior-based Pricing and Wholesale Contracting in Competing Supply Chains with Informative Advertising
affiliations: Wuhan University - School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Behavior-based Pricing and Wholesale Contracting in Competing Supply Chains with Informative Advertising
detail.abstract: The development of e-commerce has enhanced the ability of firms to identify existing and potential customers and set targeted prices accordingly, which is known as behavior-based pricing (BBP). This study investigates the effect of manufacturers' informative advertising on the strategic interaction between wholesale price contracts (long-term or short-term) and downstream pricing mechanisms (BBP or not). We consider two horizontal differentiated supply chains in which firms not only compete in prices, but also in informative advertising which is used to generate awareness of products. We find that the impact of BBP on channel members' advertising, pricing and profits is the tradeoff of multiple effects. With BBP, manufacturers will advertise less and both retailers and manufacturers prefer short-term wholesale contracts. Moreover, BBP eases the price competition in the first period but intensifies it in the second period, especially for short-term wholesale contracts. In equilibrium, BBP is adopted by retailers only when the advertising cost is low, and manufacturers choose short-term wholesale contracts. Furthermore, BBP always hurts the consumer surplus and social welfare which means that targeted measures are needed to regulate firms' price discrimination.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了制造商信息性广告对批发价格合同（长期或短期）与下游定价机制（行为定价BBP与否）之间战略互动的影响。研究发现BBP对渠道成员广告、定价和利润的影响是多种效应的权衡。采用BBP时，制造商会减少广告，零售商和制造商都偏好短期批发合同。BBP只在广告成本低时被零售商采用，且总是损害消费者剩余和社会福利。
AI.research_question: 制造商的信息性广告如何影响批发价格合同（长期/短期）与下游定价机制（行为定价BBP/非BBP）之间的战略互动？
AI.motivation: 电子商务发展增强了企业识别现有和潜在客户并据此设定针对性价格（行为定价BBP）的能力。需要研究制造商广告如何影响供应链中批发合同类型与定价机制之间的战略互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为定价理论、供应链协调理论、信息性广告理论、差异化产品竞争理论、两阶段博弈理论
AI.method: 考虑两个横向差异化的供应链，企业不仅进行价格竞争，还进行信息性广告竞争以提升产品认知度。建立两阶段博弈模型分析不同合同类型和定价机制下的均衡。
AI.findings: 1. BBP对渠道成员广告、定价和利润的影响是多种效应的权衡；2. 采用BBP时，制造商会减少广告；3. 零售商和制造商都偏好短期批发合同；4. BBP缓解第一期的价格竞争但加剧第二期的价格竞争，特别是短期合同时；5. 均衡时，BBP只在广告成本低时被零售商采用；6. BBP总是损害消费者剩余和社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了信息性广告如何调节BBP与批发合同类型之间的战略互动；2. 识别了BBP对供应链成员决策的多重效应权衡机制；3. 拓展了差异化竞争环境下行为定价的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制造商和零售商在BBP环境下的合同选择和广告策略提供决策指导；2. 指出BBP可能损害消费者福利，需要针对性监管措施；3. 帮助企业理解不同定价机制下的竞争动态。

title: Can Machines Mean? Rule-Following, Norm Enforcement, and the Limits of LLMs

detail.title: Can Machines Mean? Rule-Following, Norm Enforcement, and the Limits of LLMs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This paper argues that transformer-based Large Language Models cannot mean in the sense relevant to human language use. On a Wittgensteinian account, meaning depends on correctness conditions that are sustained through norm enforcement within shared practices. Such enforcement requires standing for answerability, including the possibility of sanction and repair, which arises only within forms of life. LLMs generate fluent and context-sensitive language by learning statistical regularities from large corpora, but they do not participate in the practices that ground correctness, nor do they possess standing for normative assessment. As a result, their outputs lack the conditions under which utterances count as meaningful assertions, promises, or commitments. Increases in scale, architectural refinement, and advances in attention mechanisms do not alter this dependency, since they affect pattern manipulation rather than participation in norm-governed practices. Similarly, physical embodiment does not bridge the gap, as sensorimotor capacities do not confer uptake into the communal, historical, and affective structures that sustain meaning. The limitation identified is therefore not contingent or technological but structural. LLMs inherit the fragility and ambiguity of human language without acquiring the normative standing required for meaning, marking a principled boundary between linguistic fluency and genuine participation in meaning-conferring practices.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，基于Transformer的大语言模型无法实现人类语言意义上的"意义"。意义依赖于在共享实践中通过规范执行维持的正确性条件，而LLMs仅学习统计规律，不参与规范实践，缺乏规范性评估地位，因此其输出不具备真正意义。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型能否实现人类语言意义上的"意义"？
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在语言生成方面取得显著进展，需要从哲学角度澄清它们是否真正具备语言意义，还是仅仅是统计模式的操纵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 维特根斯坦的语言哲学理论，强调意义依赖于共享实践中的规范执行和正确性条件，需要参与"生活形式"。
AI.method: 哲学分析/概念分析，基于维特根斯坦的意义理论对LLMs的能力进行批判性考察。
AI.findings: LLMs通过学习大型语料库的统计规律生成流畅语言，但不参与规范实践，缺乏规范性评估地位，因此无法实现真正的语言意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将维特根斯坦意义理论应用于AI语言模型分析；2. 区分语言流畅性与真正意义参与；3. 识别LLMs在意义获取上的结构性限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI伦理和评估提供哲学基础；2. 帮助理解LLMs能力的本质限制；3. 指导未来AI系统设计的方向。

title: Energy Security and Structural Transformation in Sub-Saharan Africa: Analysis in terms of Shocks
affiliations: and University of Maroua

detail.title: Energy Security and Structural Transformation in Sub-Saharan Africa: Analysis in terms of Shocks
detail.abstract: This paper analysed the relationship between energy security (availability, acceptability, develop-ability, accessibility, and affordability) and structural transformation (with new measures on employment and value-added underdeveloped, developing, and developed structural transformation progress) in Sub-Saharan Africa with a particular emphasis on oil price and political shocks. The study employed the generalized moment method on the panel vector autoregressive model with data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration and the World Bank from 2002 to 2022. Our results reveal that the progress of the high resource endowments countries from the value-added structurally underdeveloped, developing, and developed transformation stages is determined by the energy security acceptability and accessibility against its availability and develop-ability. Meanwhile, the energy security develop-ability is the unique factor that favors the low resources endowments countries' progress from the three mentioned stages and also the employment structurally developed transformation. Oppositely to the employment structurally underdeveloped and developing transformation, the energy accessibility abets the advancement of the high resource endowments countries from the employment structurally developed stage against the energy availability and acceptability. Moreover, in the low resources endowment countries, the impact of oil price shock and its combination with the political instability, decreases their progress from the employment structurally underdeveloped, developing, and developed transformation stages. Their decreasing impacts in the high resource endowment countries are more in descending order on the employment, structurally developed and developing, and the value-added structurally developed transformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了撒哈拉以南非洲地区能源安全与结构转型的关系，特别关注油价和政治冲击的影响。研究发现，高资源禀赋国家的结构转型主要受能源安全可接受性和可及性影响，而低资源禀赋国家则主要受能源安全可发展性影响。油价冲击和政治不稳定对低资源禀赋国家的就业结构转型有负面影响。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区能源安全（可用性、可接受性、可发展性、可及性和可负担性）与结构转型（就业和增加值在欠发达、发展中、发达转型阶段的衡量）之间的关系是什么？油价和政治冲击如何影响这种关系？
AI.motivation: 理解撒哈拉以南非洲地区能源安全与结构转型之间的动态关系，特别是在油价波动和政治不稳定背景下，对于该地区的可持续发展政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源安全的五个维度框架（可用性、可接受性、可发展性、可及性、可负担性）和结构转型理论，结合资源禀赋差异（高资源与低资源国家）进行分析。
AI.method: 使用面板向量自回归模型（PVAR）和广义矩估计方法，数据来源于美国能源信息管理局和世界银行（2002-2022年）。
AI.findings: 1. 高资源禀赋国家的增加值结构转型主要受能源安全可接受性和可及性影响；2. 低资源禀赋国家的结构转型主要受能源安全可发展性影响；3. 油价冲击和政治不稳定对低资源禀赋国家的就业结构转型有显著负面影响；4. 高资源禀赋国家受冲击影响程度按就业结构发达、发展中转型和增加值结构发达转型递减。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了能源安全与结构转型关系的理论理解；2. 区分了不同资源禀赋国家的影响机制差异；3. 整合了外部冲击（油价和政治）对转型过程的影响分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为撒哈拉以南非洲国家制定差异化的能源安全政策提供依据；2. 帮助政策制定者应对外部冲击对结构转型的影响；3. 为国际组织在该地区的援助和发展项目提供参考。

title: Machine Learning for Site Risk Prediction in Clinical Trials: Development, External Validation, and Operational Application in Site Qualification

detail.title: Machine Learning for Site Risk Prediction in Clinical Trials: Development, External Validation, and Operational Application in Site Qualification
detail.abstract: AbstractBackgroundSite selection and qualification represent critical operational challenges in clinical trials. Current Site Qualification Risk Assessment (SQRA) approaches—expert judgment, rule-based scoring, or historical performance—lack systematic validation. From a health informatics perspective, clinical trial data stored in disparate systems (eTMF, CTMS, ClinicalTrials.gov) remain underutilized for proactive risk prediction. We developed and validated an ML-based clinical decision support tool for site risk prediction in ATTR-CM trials with external validation in Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), designed for integration into SQRA workflows to guide Country Study Managers (CSMs) in site selection and Site Qualification Visit (SQV) decisions.MethodsWe analyzed 460 sites from 42 ATTR-CM studies and 761 sites from 89 DMD studies using data from ClinicalTrials.gov. A hybrid risk scoring system (expert consensus + LASSO optimization) captured enrollment, data quality, compliance, and complexity dimensions. Four ML algorithms were trained (n=368) and validated (n=92) using 5-fold cross-validation and temporal validation. External validation used DMD sites from different disease context and time period. SHAP analysis with bootstrap confidence intervals (1000 iterations) and permutation tests ensured interpretability. We designed an operational workflow integrating the tool into SQRA processes and projected impact based on literature-reported trial parameters.ResultsSupport Vector Machine achieved 98.91% accuracy (95% CI: 93.8%-99.9%) in ATTR-CM, correctly classifying 91 of 92 sites. Subgroup analysis showed 100% accuracy across all geographic regions and site types, confirming no algorithmic bias. External validation in DMD yielded 81.21% accuracy (95% CI: 73.3%-88.5%), demonstrating cross-disease generalizability. SHAP identified data quality risk (0.112, p<0.001), screen failure rate (0.090, p<0.001), and enrollment risk (0.084, p<0.001) as key predictors. Feature importance rankings showed high consistency between diseases (Spearman ρ=0.905, p=0.002). Projected operational impact based on literature benchmarks: potential to reduce site screening time by enabling rapid risk stratification, optimize SQV allocation by targeting high-risk sites, and improve monitoring resource allocation. Literature suggests optimized site selection and risk-based monitoring can reduce trial costs by 20-40%.ConclusionsWe developed an operational-ready ML-based tool for site risk prediction, achieving near-perfect accuracy in ATTR-CM with demonstrated cross-disease generalizability in DMD. The tool is designed for integration into SQRA workflows to support CSMs in site selection and SQV decisions. Feature importance consistency (Spearman ρ=0.905) supports applicability across diverse trial portfolios. Projected impact based on literature benchmarks includes improved screening efficiency, optimized SQV allocation, and data-driven monitoring decisions. However, critical limitations remain: lack of validation against ground truth monitoring outcomes, DMD features estimated using proxies, and projected impact not yet validated through operational deployment. This study demonstrates how health informatics can provide decision support for clinical research operations, with pilot implementation essential to validate projected benefits.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一个基于机器学习的临床决策支持工具，用于临床试验中心风险预测。该工具在ATTR-CM试验中达到98.91%的准确率，并在DMD试验中进行外部验证（81.21%准确率），展示了跨疾病泛化能力。工具设计用于整合到SQRA工作流程中，以支持国家研究经理在中心选择和资格访视决策中做出更明智的选择。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个基于机器学习的临床决策支持工具，用于预测临床试验中心的风险，并验证其在跨疾病背景下的泛化能力？
AI.motivation: 当前临床试验中心资格风险评估方法（专家判断、基于规则的评分或历史表现）缺乏系统验证。临床研究数据存储在分散的系统中（eTMF、CTMS、ClinicalTrials.gov），未能充分利用于主动风险预测。从健康信息学角度，需要开发数据驱动的决策支持工具来改进中心选择和资格访视决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康信息学、临床研究运营管理、机器学习预测模型、风险分层理论、决策支持系统理论
AI.method: 分析了来自42项ATTR-CM研究的460个中心和89项DMD研究的761个中心（数据来自ClinicalTrials.gov）。采用混合风险评分系统（专家共识+LASSO优化）捕捉入组、数据质量、合规性和复杂性维度。训练了四种ML算法（n=368）并使用5折交叉验证和时间验证进行验证（n=92）。外部验证使用不同疾病背景和时间段的DMD中心。采用SHAP分析和自举置信区间确保可解释性。设计了整合到SQRA流程中的操作工作流，并基于文献报告的试验参数预测影响。
AI.findings: 支持向量机在ATTR-CM中达到98.91%准确率（95% CI: 93.8%-99.9%），正确分类了92个中心中的91个。亚组分析显示所有地理区域和中心类型的准确率均为100%，确认无算法偏差。DMD外部验证准确率为81.21%（95% CI: 73.3%-88.5%），展示了跨疾病泛化能力。SHAP分析识别数据质量风险（0.112, p<0.001）、筛选失败率（0.090, p<0.001）和入组风险（0.084, p<0.001）为关键预测因子。特征重要性排名在疾病间高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.905, p=0.002）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了整合专家共识和机器学习优化的混合风险评分框架；2. 展示了机器学习模型在临床试验中心风险预测中的跨疾病泛化能力；3. 提供了基于SHAP的特征重要性分析，增强了模型可解释性；4. 建立了健康信息学在临床研究运营决策支持中的应用理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了操作就绪的ML工具，可直接整合到SQRA工作流程；2. 为国家研究经理提供数据驱动的中心选择和资格访视决策支持；3. 预计可减少中心筛选时间、优化资格访视分配、改进监测资源分配；4. 基于文献基准，优化中心选择和风险监测可减少试验成本20-40%；5. 为临床试验运营提供了可扩展的决策支持系统原型。

title: Contribute to MY IT Service: Encouraging Technology Extra-Role Behaviors in User-Artifact Interactions from a Psychological Ownership Perspective

detail.title: Contribute to MY IT Service: Encouraging Technology Extra-Role Behaviors in User-Artifact Interactions from a Psychological Ownership Perspective

publicationDetails.detailsText: Zou, H. M., Fang, Y., Sun, H., and Lim, K. H. “Contribute to MY IT Service: Encouraging Technology Extra-Role Behaviors in User-Artifact Interactions from a Psychological Ownership Perspective,” Information Systems Research, forthcoming

detail.abstract: Access-based and algorithm-empowered IT services (e.g., Spotify, Duolingo) have become ubiquitous, introducing a new form of user-artifact (U-A) interactions that extend beyond traditional user-user (U-U) interactions. However, the on-demand nature of these services, which fosters low perceptions of ownership, makes it challenging to retain users and encourage their voluntary contributions. Drawing on the literature on psychological ownership and extra-role behavior, this study sheds light on how the technology could be designed such that users are more likely to use the technology and to perform technology extra-role behaviors (TERBs) in U-A interactions, by examining psychological ownership of IT service (POITS) as the underlying mechanism. Employing mixed methods, this study further unveils the mechanisms of how users form such a psychological bonding with an avatarless algorithm in the human-algorithm interactions by co-constructing an extended self, advising on algorithm appreciation and AI adoption.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨在基于访问和算法赋能的IT服务中，如何通过设计技术来增强用户的心理所有权，从而促进用户持续使用和自愿贡献行为。
AI.research_question: 在用户-算法（U-A）交互中，技术应如何设计才能增强用户的心理所有权，从而促进技术使用和技术额外角色行为（TERBs）？
AI.motivation: 基于访问和算法赋能的IT服务（如Spotify、Duolingo）普遍存在，但其按需性质导致用户所有权感知低，难以留住用户并鼓励其自愿贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理所有权理论和额外角色行为理论，探讨用户-算法交互中的心理所有权形成机制。
AI.method: 混合方法研究，结合定量和定性分析，探索用户与无头像算法形成心理联结的机制。
AI.findings: 揭示了用户如何通过与算法共同构建扩展自我来形成心理所有权，为算法欣赏和AI采纳提供建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了心理所有权理论在用户-算法交互中的应用，提出了IT服务心理所有权（POITS）作为中介机制，丰富了人机交互理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为算法服务设计提供指导，帮助提高用户留存率和自愿贡献，促进算法欣赏和AI采纳。

title: Dynamic Delegation in Human-AI Collaboration: Heuristic-Based and Instance-Based Decision-Making
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Information Systems and City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: Dynamic Delegation in Human-AI Collaboration: Heuristic-Based and Instance-Based Decision-Making
detail.abstract: This study examines how humans collaborate with an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) partner capable of achieving decision automation independently, despite operating through fundamentally different mechanisms. Focusing on AI implementation within an operations management context, we conduct a longitudinal study involving the daily delegation decisions of 981 human managers. Findings show that managers tend to employ inertial heuristics stemming from their perception of limited AI cognitive capabilities, resulting in fewer tasks delegated to AI when AI's operation diverges from managers' routine operations. Conversely, managers are more inclined to delegate to AI when it demonstrates superior performance informed by adaptively accumulated instances from successful past delegations. Interestingly, while AI divergence can initially impede collaboration, it also encourages managers to recognize their potential inertial cognitive bias, where reliance on familiar norms reduces their focus on evaluating AI divergence that may yield better performance. This interplay between AI divergence and outperformance becomes evident in ongoing human-AI collaborations, which are shaped by managers' delegation experience, situational consistency, and task risk assessments. This study sheds light on the human-AI delegation decision-making as a dynamic learning process and offers insights on directing the pathway toward human-AI collaborative intelligence.

AI.tldr: 人类管理者在与具有自主决策能力的AI合作时，倾向于使用惯性启发式思维，当AI运作方式与管理者常规操作不同时会减少任务委托，但当AI展现基于成功委托历史积累的优异性能时会更愿意委托。AI差异性与优异表现的相互作用塑造了动态的人机协作学习过程。
AI.research_question: 人类管理者如何与具有自主决策能力的AI伙伴协作？当AI的运作机制与管理者常规操作存在根本差异时，管理者如何做出委托决策？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在运营管理中的广泛应用，理解人类如何与具有自主决策能力的AI协作变得至关重要。现有研究较少关注当AI运作机制与人类常规操作存在根本差异时的人机协作动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 惯性启发式理论、认知偏差理论、委托决策理论、人机协作理论
AI.method: 纵向研究，涉及981名人类管理者的日常委托决策
AI.findings: 1) 管理者倾向于使用惯性启发式思维，认为AI认知能力有限，当AI运作方式与管理者常规操作不同时会减少任务委托；2) 当AI展现基于成功委托历史积累的优异性能时，管理者更愿意委托；3) AI差异性虽然最初阻碍协作，但促使管理者认识到潜在的惯性认知偏差；4) AI差异性与优异表现的相互作用受到管理者委托经验、情境一致性和任务风险评估的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将人机委托决策概念化为动态学习过程；2) 揭示了惯性启发式在AI协作中的作用；3) 阐明了AI差异性与优异表现之间的复杂相互作用；4) 拓展了人机协作理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为组织设计更有效的人机协作系统提供指导；2) 帮助管理者识别和克服惯性认知偏差；3) 为AI系统设计提供启示，如何通过展示优异性能来促进委托；4) 为培训管理者与AI协作提供实践建议。

title: Mediation Design by an Informed Party
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia

detail.title: Mediation Design by an Informed Party

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This manuscript reflects only the author’s views and opinions, neither the European Union nor the European Commission can be considered responsible for them.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received funding from the European Union through the Next-Generation EU/Italian National Recovery and Resilience Plan (NRRP)—Mission 4, Component 2, Investment 1.1: Fondo per il Programma Nazionale di Ricerca e Progetti di Rilevante Interesse Nazionale (PRIN)—Project number 2022WS8AJY–CUP H53D23002600006.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates mediation design by an informed party—the expert—who selects a mediation mechanism at the interim stage, i.e., after observing her private information. We consider a basic strategic environment in which the expert's information is a binary state of the world and an uninformed decision-maker chooses an action on the real line. Preferences are quadratic, with state-contingent bliss points that differ across parties. Our framework is closely related to the informed-principal problem, and our analysis builds on its foundational results. To delimit the reasonable predictions of the interim mediation design game, we sequentially refine the set of perfect Bayesian equilibrium outcomes by applying several solution concepts: the strong solution, core mechanisms, neologism-proof equilibria, and the neo-optimum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究知情方（专家）在观察到私人信息后选择调解机制的设计问题。在二元状态、二次偏好、不同理想点的战略环境中，作者应用多种解概念（强解、核心机制、新语证明均衡、新最优）来精炼完美贝叶斯均衡结果。
AI.research_question: 知情方（专家）在观察到私人信息后如何设计调解机制？哪些调解机制在各种解概念下是合理的？
AI.motivation: 调解机制设计通常假设设计者在事前（观察信息前）选择机制，但现实中许多调解发生在信息不对称已经存在之后。本文关注这种"期中"调解设计问题，填补了理论空白。

detail.abstract: Climate change is increasingly amplifying health risks in West Africa, with disproportionate impacts on children, low-income households, and fragile public health systems. Rising temperatures, flooding, and rainfall variability are driving higher incidence of vector-borne and waterborne diseases, while government responses remain largely reactive and treatment-focused. This approach places sustained fiscal pressure on public budgets and exposes households to catastrophic out-of-pocket health expenditures (OOPE). This study advances Climate-Health Literacy (CHL) integration into national secondary school curricula as a preventive, low-cost, and high-return public health investment. Using a mixed-methods design that combines regional curriculum analysis, applied curriculum modeling, and a 20-year cost-benefit analysis (CBA), the paper estimates the economic and social returns of embedding CHL into formal education systems across West Africa. Results indicate that proactive CHL investment substantially reduces disease incidence, OOPE, and human capital losses, generating an estimated return on investment (ROI) of 3.67:1. The paper contributes original evidence to climate-health economics by quantifying educationsector adaptation benefits and offering a practical, scalable policy framework aligned with SDGs 3, 4, and 13.

title: The Double Shield Effect: Institutional Failure of Responsibility Attribution in Corporate AI Deployment

detail.title: The Double Shield Effect: Institutional Failure of Responsibility Attribution in Corporate AI Deployment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: Contemporary AI-mediated corporate decision-making reveals a recurring failure of responsibility attribution: accountability does not stabilize on identifiable actors. This paper identifies and analyzes this institutional pathology, termed the Double Shield Effect. The effect arises when two attributional buffers operate jointly. First, corporate delegation structures distribute decision authority across roles, procedures, and approvals, insulating individual actors while preserving organizational action. Second, AI-mediated decision systems are treated institutionally as operationally relied-upon outputs that are not authored by any individual at the point of action. When these two features interact, responsibility can be procedurally redirected across organizational and technical layers without settling on any actor recognized as sanctionable. The analysis is strictly institutional and diagnostic. It does not treat AI systems as moral agents, nor does it posit new ontological categories or rely on emergent or hybrid agency claims. Accountability failure under Double Shield conditions is not reducible to system opacity, diffusion of responsibility, or ordinary limited liability. Instead, it reflects the interaction of existing governance and legal structures with procedural delegation and AI-mediated outputs. The argument draws on tightly specified, real-world cases from algorithmic hiring and automated credit underwriting to trace how responsibility cycles rather than terminates. The diagnostic insight is that existing accountability frameworks fail when institutional arrangements allow responsibility to relocate after harm. This highlights the central role of attributional structure in stabilizing corporate accountability and underscores that effective governance must intervene at the level of attributional permissions rather than merely improving information, transparency, or procedural oversight.

AI.tldr: 论文识别并分析了"双重屏蔽效应"——当公司委托结构和AI决策系统相互作用时，责任无法稳定归属于可识别的行动者，导致问责失败。

AI.method: 严格的制度诊断分析，基于具体现实案例（算法招聘和自动化信用承销）追踪责任如何在组织和技术的循环而非终止。

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供诊断工具，识别现有问责框架在制度安排允许责任在损害发生后重新定位时的失败。强调需要改变归因结构而非仅仅增加透明度。

title: HCUPtools: An R Package for Streamlined Access to Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project Resources

detail.title: HCUPtools: An R Package for Streamlined Access to Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project Resources
detail.abstract: Healthcare data analysis requires efficient access to standardized classification systems and statistical resources. The Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project (HCUP) provides essential tools including Clinical Classifications Software Refined (CCSR) mapping files and Summary Trend Tables, but manual access and processing can be time-consuming and error-prone. HCUPtools is an open-source R package that streamlines access to publicly available HCUP resources, enabling researchers and healthcare analysts to efficiently map International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) codes to CCSR categories and access aggregated hospital utilization statistics. The package provides automated download capabilities, multiple output formats for different analytical needs, version management, and intelligent caching. A systematic performance benchmark demonstrates a 96% reduction in processing time compared with manual workflows (112.5 minutes to 4.5 minutes). HCUPtools supports all four types of healthcare analytics: descriptive (historical trend analysis), diagnostic (pattern identification), predictive (data preparation for modeling), and prescriptive (evidence-based decision support). The package facilitates compliance with HCUP data use policies by ensuring direct access to official sources and automatic citation generation. HCUPtools is available on the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) and has been designed to improve the efficiency and reproducibility of healthcare data analysis workflows.

AI.tldr: HCUPtools是一个开源R包，通过自动化访问AHRQ HCUP资源，将ICD-10代码映射到CCSR类别并获取医院使用统计数据，显著提高医疗数据分析效率。

AI.findings: 与手动工作流程相比，处理时间减少96%（从112.5分钟降至4.5分钟）；支持所有四种医疗分析类型；确保数据使用政策合规性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了医疗数据访问自动化的理论框架；扩展了可重复性研究在医疗数据分析中的应用；为标准化分类系统的高效利用提供了理论支持。

title: "Old New Donors": Development Cooperation Policies of the Gulf Monarchies
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: "Old New Donors": Development Cooperation Policies of the Gulf Monarchies
detail.abstract: For several decades, the monarchies of the Persian Gulf have been important providers of development finance, yet their approaches to aid do not receive as much research attention as those of the OECD Development Assistance Committee (DAC). This paper offers a concise political-economy overview of development cooperation by the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) monarchies. It argues that these states have developed a distinctive model of development cooperation with growing institutionalization and engagement in multilateral platforms. The analysis highlights several core features: high generosity relative to gross national income (GNI), a strong regional and Islamic focus, the predominance of bilateral channels and budget support, extensive use of Islamic financial instruments, and relatively low transparency and formal conditionality. It also underlines the central role of national development funds, religiously inspired organizations and multilateral institutions such as the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) and the Arab Coordination Group (ACG). The study cocludes that Gulf development cooperation cannot be understood simply as altruistic charity or "checkbook diplomacy" but as a hybrid model embedded in the broader transformation of the global aid regime and emerging Non-Western models of aid.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了海湾合作委员会（GCC）君主国的发展合作模式，指出其具有独特的制度化和多边参与特征，既非纯粹的利他主义慈善，也非简单的"支票簿外交"，而是嵌入全球援助体系转型中的混合模式。
AI.research_question: 海湾合作委员会（GCC）君主国的发展合作模式有哪些核心特征？如何理解这种模式在全球援助体系中的定位？
AI.motivation: 尽管海湾君主国几十年来一直是重要的发展融资提供者，但其援助方式相比经合组织发展援助委员会（DAC）国家获得的研究关注较少，需要系统分析其独特的发展合作模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架，全球援助体系转型理论，非西方援助模式理论，制度主义理论。
AI.method: 政治经济学概述分析，文献综述，制度分析，比较分析（与OECD DAC模式对比）。
AI.findings: GCC发展合作具有六个核心特征：1）相对于国民总收入（GNI）的高慷慨度；2）强烈的区域性和伊斯兰焦点；3）双边渠道和预算支持占主导；4）广泛使用伊斯兰金融工具；5）相对较低的透明度和正式条件性；6）国家发展基金、宗教组织及伊斯兰开发银行等多边机构的中心作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了GCC发展合作的"混合模式"理论，超越了传统的"利他主义慈善"和"支票簿外交"二元对立，将其置于全球援助体系转型和非西方援助模式兴起的背景下理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解GCC援助模式的系统框架，有助于改进国际发展合作实践，促进西方与非西方援助模式的对话与协调。

title: The Appraisal Mechanism: Spillover Effects of All-Cash Sales on Local Housing Markets
affiliations: University of North Carolina Kenan-Flagler Business School

detail.title: The Appraisal Mechanism: Spillover Effects of All-Cash Sales on Local Housing Markets
detail.abstract: Discounted nearby all-cash sales enter the comparable set used by appraisers, depress appraised values for mortgage purchases, and cap financing, so financed deals either (i) bridge with cash, (ii) renegotiate, or (iii) fail. Based on a ring-based design using matched deed-mortgagelisting data from 2018 to 2022, I find that a one-standard-deviation increase in proximate cash activity lowers appraisals by 1.39% and sale prices by 1.38% and lengthens time-on-market by 38 days. This spillover is highly local and recent, favoring the renegotiation channel over cash-gap bridging. These effects are more pronounced for low-income, high-LTV, first-time, and minority buyers and in low-inventory neighborhoods, consistent with negotiation-driven information revelation that shifts surplus toward constrained buyers. Additional evidence links higher nearby cash activity to more HMDA "approved-but-not-accepted" outcomes, supporting a failure channel. A bargaining model with appraisal-anchored caps rationalizes the near one-for-one appraisal-to-price pass-through and maps welfare: spillovers mainly redistribute surplus in thick, high-growth markets but generate exclusion and misallocation in thin, low-growth markets.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，附近的全现金交易会压低房产评估价值，限制抵押贷款购房者的融资能力，导致交易失败或需要重新谈判。基于2018-2022年匹配的产权-抵押贷款-挂牌数据，研究发现附近现金活动增加一个标准差会使评估价值降低1.39%，销售价格降低1.38%，市场停留时间延长38天。这些影响对低收入、高贷款价值比、首次购房者和少数族裔买家更为显著。
AI.research_question: 附近的全现金交易如何影响抵押贷款购房的房产评估价值、销售价格和交易结果？
AI.motivation: 在房地产市场中，全现金交易通常以折扣价成交，这些交易会被评估师用作可比销售数据，从而压低抵押贷款购房的评估价值，限制融资能力，导致交易失败或需要重新谈判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于谈判模型，其中评估价值作为融资上限的锚点，解释评估价值到销售价格的近乎一对一传递效应，并分析福利影响：在流动性高、增长快的市场中，溢出效应主要重新分配剩余；在流动性差、增长慢的市场中，则产生排斥和错配。
AI.method: 采用环形设计，使用2018-2022年匹配的产权-抵押贷款-挂牌数据，分析附近现金活动对评估价值、销售价格和市场停留时间的影响。
AI.findings: 附近现金活动增加一个标准差会使评估价值降低1.39%，销售价格降低1.38%，市场停留时间延长38天。这些溢出效应具有高度局部性和时效性，支持重新谈判渠道而非现金缺口填补。对低收入、高贷款价值比、首次购房者和少数族裔买家影响更显著，在低库存社区尤为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于评估锚定的谈判模型，解释了评估价值到销售价格的近乎一对一传递机制，并分析了不同市场条件下的福利分配效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了全现金交易对抵押贷款购房者的负面影响，特别是对弱势群体的不平等效应，为政策制定者提供了改善住房市场公平性的依据，并帮助市场参与者理解交易失败的风险因素。

detail.abstract:
This Doctrine advances a novel structural theory of American constitutional governance: Constitutional Self-Correction (CSC). Departing from conventional accounts that equate democratic legitimacy with electoral mandate, institutional efficiency, or policy output, CSC reframes the Constitution as a temporally sequenced, rule-bound signaling system. Its purpose is not to maximize responsiveness, but to translate civic stress into lawful action—or lawful restraint—without collapsing authority into immediacy, sentiment, or force.

The core contribution of this work is a formal distinction between constitutional stress and constitutional compulsion, articulated through two analytical layers: Constitutional Stress Indicators (CSI) and Constitutional Compulsion Indicators (CCI). CSI consist of continuous, non-binding signals generated by democratic life—speech, elections, dissent, volatility, and institutional friction—which invite deliberation but do not authorize action. CCI arise only when constitutionally specified legal thresholds are crossed, triggering mandatory outcomes irrespective of political preference, most notably through Article I, Section 9’s appropriations constraint. This distinction resolves persistent category errors in modern constitutional discourse that treat urgency as authority and delay as dysfunction.

Building on this framework, the Doctrine reconceptualizes core constitutional structures as components of an integrated signal-processing architecture. Voters function as a distributed sensing network rather than a command source; the House of Representatives operates as a high-frequency democratic sensor; the Senate serves as a low-frequency constitutional stabilizer; and divided government performs a critical pressure-absorption role that preserves future legitimacy. Bicameralism, temporal delay, and even governmental cessation are shown not as failures of governance, but as fidelity mechanisms that discipline power through endurance rather than acceleration.

The Doctrine further challenges prevailing narratives of “gridlock,” “power grabs,” and “output legitimacy,” demonstrating how efficiency-based evaluations of governance erode constitutional authority by rewarding bypass over restraint. It reinterprets federal shutdowns as constitutionally compelled conscience events rather than institutional breakdowns, and situates moments of unified government within a recurring historical pattern of lawful constitutional delivery following prolonged restraint, not domination.

Ultimately, this work offers a systems-level model of constitutional governance that integrates voter behavior, legislative structure, appropriations law, and judicial restraint into a coherent theory of democratic endurance. Constitutional Self-Correction does not prescribe outcomes or predict ideological direction. It explains how a free people govern themselves over time—by listening before acting, restraining before aligning, and obeying law even when pressure is greatest. Legitimacy, on this account, arises from structure, sequence, and restraint, not from speed, sentiment, or force.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"宪法自我修正"理论，将美国宪法重构为一个时序化、规则约束的信号系统，区分宪法压力与宪法强制，认为宪法治理的核心不是最大化响应速度，而是通过结构性机制将公民压力转化为合法行动或约束。

AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法自我修正理论、宪法压力与宪法强制区分、宪法压力指标与宪法强制指标、宪法作为信号处理系统的架构理论。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析，通过区分宪法压力指标和宪法强制指标，重构宪法结构作为集成信号处理架构的组成部分。
AI.findings: 1. 选民是分布式传感网络而非命令源；2. 众议院是高频率民主传感器；3. 参议院是低频率宪法稳定器；4. 分权政府承担关键压力吸收功能；5. 两院制、时间延迟甚至政府停摆都是宪法忠诚机制而非治理失败。

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 重新解释联邦政府停摆为宪法强制良心事件而非制度崩溃；2. 为宪法治理中的延迟和约束提供正当性解释；3. 为评估宪法治理提供新框架，强调结构、时序和约束而非效率。

title: Extracting Forward Equity Return Expectations Using Derivatives
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Charlotte, University of North Carolina  (UNC) at Wilmington and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Charlotte - Belk College of Business

detail.title: Extracting Forward Equity Return Expectations Using Derivatives
detail.abstract: This paper develops a framework for extracting conditional expectations of future equity returns from derivative prices. We show that expected returns can be identified not only at the spot horizon, but also for forward-starting investment periods, yielding the full surface of expected future returns. Using index options, we derive theoretical bounds on future returns, and using VIX derivatives, we link risk-neutral and real-world expectations. Empirically, derivative-implied expectations exhibit sharp shifts around major crises, reveal persistent negative dependence between adjacent monthly returns, and generate economically valuable reversal signals. These findings uncover new dimensions of return predictability embedded in derivatives markets.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个从衍生品价格中提取未来股票收益条件期望的框架，能够识别即期和远期投资期的预期收益，形成完整的预期收益曲面。利用指数期权推导未来收益的理论边界，通过VIX衍生品连接风险中性与现实世界期望。实证发现衍生品隐含的预期在危机期间急剧变化，揭示相邻月度收益间的持续负相关性，并产生具有经济价值的反转信号。

title: Pattern Recognition of Gold and Mercury Supply Chain in Global Trade Data
affiliations: Asia School of Business in collaboration with MIT Sloan

detail.title: Pattern Recognition of Gold and Mercury Supply Chain in Global Trade Data
detail.abstract: Despite the Minamata Convention's targeted reductions in mercury consumption, global trade data exhibits a 'Compliance Paradox' where reported flows vanish while artisanal gold mining output remains stable. This research proposes a 'Mineral Intelligence' pipeline utilizing unsupervised machine learning to detect illicit mercury trafficking disguised as Electronic Waste (HS 8549). By applying Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM) and Isolation Forest algorithms to UN Comtrade data (2020-2024), we identify a systemic 'Balloon Effect': as elemental mercury bans took effect in 2022, illicit volumes were structurally displaced into 'fake waste' classifications. Forensic analysis reveals a statistically significant 'Smuggler's Signature' within these flows, characterized by a price anomaly of $24-$80/kg (mirroring liquid mercury markets) and a Netto-Gross weight ratio exceeding 90%, physically corresponding to standard 34.5 kg steel mercury flasks. Furthermore, Node2Vec and spectral embedding analysis exposes a 'Decoupling Chasm' (Manifold Distance: 2.06) that topologically separates financial gold hubs from mercury-intensive mining zones. Finally, Recursive LSTM forecasts predict a 'burnout' of the current HS 8549 smuggling vector (-618M kg/yr), warning of an imminent regime shift toward chemically masked commodities.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个"矿物情报"管道，利用无监督机器学习检测伪装成电子废物（HS 8549）的非法汞走私。研究发现，随着2022年元素汞禁令生效，非法汞贸易被结构性转移到"虚假废物"分类中，形成了"气球效应"。分析揭示了走私活动的统计特征，并预测当前走私渠道将面临"燃尽"，可能转向化学掩蔽商品。

3. 使用递归LSTM模型进行预测分析

3. 揭示"脱钩鸿沟"：金融黄金枢纽与汞密集型矿区在拓扑上分离（流形距离：2.06）

title: Who Speaks for the Algorithm? Attribution in Environmental Decision making
affiliations: Emory University School of Law

detail.title: Who Speaks for the Algorithm? Attribution in Environmental Decision making
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping environmental decision-making, yet administrative law has failed to articulate who, if anyone, is legally responsible for algorithmically generated analysis. Federal agencies increasingly rely on AI tools tomodel environmental impacts, project emissions, and synthesize massiveadministrative records under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA). As algorithmic systems move from peripheral support to the analytic core of Environmental Impact Statements, a foundational legal question emerges: whenanagency relies on artificial intelligence, whose reasoning is the law reviewing? Recent Supreme Court decisions—including Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo and Seven County Infrastructure Coalition v. Eagle County—haveintensified this problem. By rejecting automatic deference and reaf irming that deference must be earned through reasoned explanation, the Court has placedrenewed emphasis on identifiable agency judgment. Yet existing administrativedoctrine presupposes human authorship and of ers no framework for determiningwhether algorithmic analysis can be attributed to the agency itself. As a result, environmental review risks becoming scientifically sophisticated yet legallyunowned—producing decisions that are transparent but not accountable, disclosedbut not attributable. This Article identifies a doctrinal vacuum at the intersection of administrative law, environmental governance, and artificial intelligence. It argues that courts andagencies have conflated two distinct inquiries: attribution and reliability. Beforecourts can assess whether AI-assisted environmental analysis is scientifically sound, they must first determine whether that analysis is legally attributable to the agency as institutional judgment. Attribution, this Article contends, is the threshold conditionof judicial review. To fill this gap, the Article proposes the Attribution and Adoption Test (AAT)—a governance framework for determining when algorithmically generatedenvironmental analysis may be treated as the agency’s own reasoning under theAdministrative Procedure Act and NEPA. The AAT operationalizes attributionthrough three dimensions: Institutional Control and Adoption, Epistemic Integrity, and Public Traceability. Rather than mandating technical audits or disclosure of proprietary code, the framework focuses on whether the administrative recorddemonstrates a transparent institutional chain of reasoning suf icient to support judicial review. By reconceptualizing attribution as a distinct procedural inquiry, this Articlerestores doctrinal coherence to environmental review in the algorithmic era. It of ers courts a principled basis for calibrating remedies, agencies a clear complianceroadmap, and administrative law a mechanism to preserve accountability without abandoning technological innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能在环境决策中的应用引发的法律问责问题，提出"归因与采纳测试"框架来解决算法分析的法律归属难题。

AI.motivation: 人工智能正重塑环境决策，但行政法未能明确算法生成分析的法律责任归属。随着AI从辅助工具变为环境影响评估的核心，法律问责出现真空。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政法理论、环境治理理论、人工智能问责理论，特别是归因理论与可靠性理论的区分。
AI.method: 法律文献分析、判例研究、理论构建方法，提出"归因与采纳测试"的概念框架。

AI.practical_contributions: 为法院提供校准救济的原则基础；为机构提供明确的合规路线图；为行政法提供保持问责同时不放弃技术创新的机制。

title: Patents, Power, and the Right to Health: How Pharmaceutical Intellectual Property Governance Undermines Equitable Access to Essential Medicines

detail.title: Patents, Power, and the Right to Health: How Pharmaceutical Intellectual Property Governance Undermines Equitable Access to Essential Medicines

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information and therefore did not require ethics committee approval or informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Many health systems around the world have adopted intellectual property (IP) rules to determine who can access essential medicines and under what conditions, though this type of IP protection is frequently justified as a means to promote innovation. This paper contends that in many cases, contemporary pharmaceutical IP governance undermines equitable access to care, particularly for the most vulnerable populations, by enabling market concentration, constraining research pathways, and delaying the development and distribution of essential medicines. To support this argument, the paper draws on examples including biologics, epinephrine auto-injectors, insulin, genetic tests, and COVID-19 vaccine manufacturing technologies to show how pharmaceutical companies have utilized patent protection strategies to establish monopolies and increase prices beyond the affordability of most patients, including evergreening, patent thickets, and defensive patenting. The paper also examines the implications of this analysis from the perspective of a human rights-based approach to health, emphasizing the duty of states to ensure that all individuals have access to essential medicines without discrimination. The paper concludes with an overview of how to reframe access to essential medicines as an integral component of the right to health, and subsequently, how to create a system that supports innovation while promoting equity.

AI.tldr: 本文认为当代药品知识产权治理通过市场集中、限制研究路径和延迟药品开发分发，损害了医疗公平可及性，特别是对弱势群体。文章以生物制剂、胰岛素、COVID-19疫苗等为例，分析药企如何利用专利策略建立垄断并抬高价格，最后从人权角度提出重构药品可及性作为健康权组成部分的框架。

title: Is there a "Bamboo Ceiling" for Asian Economists? Challenges for Asian Economists in the Profession
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Is there a "Bamboo Ceiling" for Asian Economists? Challenges for Asian Economists in the Profession
detail.abstract: We document the growing representation of Asian economists in US economics academia, but also a pronounced "Bamboo Ceiling": their representation declines sharply in more prestigious positions. Drawing on multiple data sources-including a Census survey of economics Ph.D. recipients in the United States, web-scraped information from US economics departments, journals, and the Econ Job Market Rumors website, our professional climate surveys, and in-depth interviews-we examine potential drivers of this racial gap in representation. We find substantial disparities in how Asian economists-particularly those of East Asian origin-are perceived and treated within the profession. We conclude by discussing potential measures to reduce the career disadvantages they face.

detail.abstract: Valuations of real estate assets, whether produced by human appraisers or automated valuation models (AVMs), represent noisy but informative signals of a property's fundamental value. When multiple independent valuations are available, combining them can diversify model-specific errors and give more reliable price predictions. This paper evaluates a broad set of ensemble strategies for fusing outputs from different valuation sources, using transaction data from 51,745 condominium sales in Norway. We compare conventional aggregation techniques such as arithmetic averaging and meta-learning with an uncertainty-weighted ensemble that assigns higher weight to valuations with lower expected error. Across repeated out-of-sample tests, the uncertainty-weighted approach consistently achieves the lowest prediction errors, with gains achieved across sample size, housing type, and location. We further show that meta-learning offers modest improvements when combined valuations have similar uncertainty but underperforms when uncertainty varies or training data is limited. The results demonstrate that incorporating uncertainty into valuation fusion provides a robust framework for enhancing accuracy and transparency in both human and machine valuation contexts.

AI.motivation: 房地产估值存在噪声，但包含资产基本价值的信息。当有多个独立估值可用时，结合它们可以分散模型特定误差，提供更可靠的价格预测。需要评估不同的集成策略来优化估值融合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（估值作为基本价值的噪声信号）、集成学习理论、不确定性量化理论、预测融合理论
AI.method: 使用挪威51,745套公寓销售的交易数据，比较了多种集成策略：算术平均、元学习（meta-learning）和不确定性加权集成（给预期误差较低的估值分配更高权重）。通过重复的样本外测试进行评估。
AI.findings: 不确定性加权方法在所有样本大小、住房类型和地点上都始终实现最低的预测误差。元学习在估值具有相似不确定性且训练数据充足时提供适度改进，但在不确定性变化或训练数据有限时表现不佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将不确定性纳入估值融合的理论框架，展示了不确定性加权在集成学习中的优势，为信号融合理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产评估实践提供了有效的估值融合方法，提高了人类和机器估值场景下的准确性和透明度，为金融机构、评估师和政策制定者提供了实用的决策工具。

title: Randomized Experiments in the Science of Science: The Case of Peer Review and the Evaluation of New Knowledge
affiliations: Northeastern University (USA)

detail.title: Randomized Experiments in the Science of Science: The Case of Peer Review and the Evaluation of New Knowledge
detail.abstract: Peer review governs the allocation of scientific opportunity, yet the functioning and performance of this institution have been subjected to only limited systematic causal investigation. This chapter synthesizes the body of published experimental studies embedded in journals, conferences, and funding agencies, asking what these interventions reveal about how peer review functions, where reform may be plausible, and which directions for future experimentation are most promising. Organizing the evidence through a unified Q-A-R-S framework, the chapter documents a sharp empirical asymmetry in the experimental evidence: most system interventions studied thus far reliably shift participation, timing, compliance, and other behavioral margins, while core evaluative judgments respond primarily to who evaluates the work and their knowledge and expertise. Taken together, the evidence also suggests systematic differences between the task of fine-grained rank ordering among acceptable submissions and the task of filtering clearly unacceptable work. The chapter synthesizes these findings to clarify which aspects of peer review appear empirically responsive to institutional and system-level intervention, which appear more tightly constrained by the epistemic demands of evaluation at the knowledge frontier, and where further experimental research is most likely to be informative.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过综合已发表的实验研究，分析了同行评审的功能与改革可能性，发现系统干预主要影响参与度、时间等行为层面，而核心评价判断主要取决于评审者的知识与专长。

AI.motivation: 同行评审支配着科学机会的分配，但其功能和绩效缺乏系统的因果研究，需要了解哪些方面可以通过制度干预改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用统一的Q-A-R-S框架组织证据，区分系统干预与评审者专业知识对评审结果的不同影响。
AI.method: 综合已发表的实验研究，这些实验嵌入在期刊、会议和资助机构的实际评审过程中。
