AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了同行评审中哪些方面对制度干预敏感，哪些受知识前沿评价的认知需求约束；2. 提供了系统分析同行评审实验证据的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为同行评审改革提供实证依据；2. 指出了未来实验研究最有前景的方向；3. 帮助科研机构更有效地设计和改进评审流程。

title: A Brand Under Stress: Did Chicago School Economists Become Keynesians During the Great Recession?
affiliations: Davidson College

detail.title: A Brand Under Stress: Did Chicago School Economists Become Keynesians During the Great Recession?
detail.abstract: In this paper, I examine whether Chicago School economists revised their long-standing opposition to fiscal stimulus during the Great Recession. I construct a historical narrative from a corpus of primary documents spanning January 2007 to December 2012. I include an economist in my sample if the economist meets three criteria: i) obtained a PhD in economics from the University of Chicago; ii) held a tenured professorial appointment in economics or finance at the University of Chicago before January 1, 2007, and during 2007-2012; and iii) publicly identified as a member of the Chicago School of Economics. I find that economists in my sample largely opposed fiscal stimulus during the Great Recession.

title: Uncertainty-Adjusted Sorting for Asset Pricing with Machine Learning
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Faculty of Business and Economics, The University of Hong Kong, Tsinghua University and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST)

detail.title: Uncertainty-Adjusted Sorting for Asset Pricing with Machine Learning
detail.abstract: Machine learning is central to empirical asset pricing, but portfolio construction still relies on point predictions and largely ignores asset-specific estimation uncertainty. We propose a simple change: sort assets using uncertainty-adjusted prediction bounds instead of point predictions alone. Across a broad set of ML models and a U.S. equity panel, this approach improves portfolio performance relative to point-prediction sorting. These gains persist even when bounds are built from partial or misspecified uncertainty information. They arise mainly from reduced volatility and are strongest for flexible machine learning models. Identification and robustness exercises show that these improvements are driven by asset-level rather than time or aggregate predictive uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用不确定性调整的预测边界而非点预测来对资产进行排序，这种方法在多种机器学习模型和美国股票数据中都能改善投资组合表现，主要收益来自降低波动性。

AI.motivation: 机器学习在实证资产定价中日益重要，但当前投资组合构建主要依赖点预测，忽视了资产特定的估计不确定性，这可能限制了投资组合的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于预测不确定性的投资组合理论，将资产排序从单纯依赖点预测扩展到考虑预测边界和不确定性调整。
AI.method: 提出使用不确定性调整的预测边界对资产进行排序，而非仅使用点预测。在美国股票面板数据上测试多种机器学习模型，进行识别和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 使用不确定性调整的预测边界排序相比点预测排序能改善投资组合表现，即使边界基于部分或错误指定的不确定性信息。收益主要来自降低波动性，对灵活的机器学习模型效果最明显。改进主要由资产层面的不确定性驱动，而非时间或总体预测不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不确定性信息整合到机器学习驱动的资产定价框架中，提出了一种新的基于预测边界的资产排序方法，丰富了投资组合构建的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了一种简单实用的方法：在资产排序时考虑预测不确定性，这可以改善投资组合的风险调整后收益，特别适用于复杂的机器学习模型。

title: The Politics of Curriculum: The Removal of Bangabandhu's Image and the Rewriting of National History in Bangladesh

detail.title: The Politics of Curriculum: The Removal of Bangabandhu's Image and the Rewriting of National History in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Curriculum is not merely an educational instrument; it is a powerful political text through which nations construct identity, legitimacy, and historical memory. This study examines the political implications of the recent removal of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's image from school textbooks in Bangladesh, situating the event within broader debates on historical revisionism, symbolic politics, and state power. Using qualitative content analysis of policy documents, textbooks, public statements, and media discourse, the research explores how curriculum reform becomes a site of ideological struggle during political transitions. The findings demonstrate that the symbolic exclusion of Bangabandhu represents not simply an educational revision but a deliberate attempt to reshape national consciousness, weaken foundational narratives of the Liberation War, and reconfigure political legitimacy. The article argues that such acts of curricular revisionism risk destabilizing democratic identity, promoting historical amnesia, and deepening political polarization. The study contributes to critical curriculum theory and memory studies by illustrating how postcolonial states weaponize education in struggles over power and historical authority.

title: Bye Bye Beta: Deposit Duration with Fixed Spreads
affiliations: London School of Economics

detail.title: Bye Bye Beta: Deposit Duration with Fixed Spreads
detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates that very low interest rates reduce bank deposit franchise value. I make three empirical claims: First, long-term deposit passthrough is high when rates are high, but near zero when rates are near zero. Second, modeling this non-linearity reveals that deposit franchise duration becomes negative at low rates, even without any deposit runoff or fixed costs. Third, this measure accurately predicts bank stock responses to monetary policy shocks, while other bank duration measures fail. This time-varying sensitivity helps explain why banks accumulated long-term securities during low-rate periods: to hedge against rates staying low.

title: Digital Governance and Public Participation: Assessing the Impact of E-Government Initiatives in India

detail.title: Digital Governance and Public Participation: Assessing the Impact of E-Government Initiatives in India
detail.abstract: This research paper examines the impact of digital governance initiatives on public participation in India, analyzing the transformation brought by e-government programs since the launch of Digital India in 2015. Through secondary data analysis and comparative case studies, this study evaluates India's progress in digital governance against global benchmarks while identifying opportunities and challenges in enhancing citizen engagement. The findings reveal that while India has achieved significant scale in digital infrastructure and service delivery, ranking as the world's third-largest digitalized economy, it faces persistent challenges in bridging the digital divide and improving its global e-government ranking 107th in UN E Government Survey 2024. The study contributes to political science and public affairs literature by providing insights into digital transformation in developing democracies and offers policy recommendations for strengthening e-governance frameworks.

title: LeyesX Identity Risk Governance Framework (IRG): A Human-Centric Cyber-Intelligence Architecture for High-Risk Digital Economies

detail.title: LeyesX Identity Risk Governance Framework (IRG): A Human-Centric Cyber-Intelligence Architecture for High-Risk Digital Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, personal, or institutional interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, human subjects research, or the use of identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: The digitalization of the global economy has altered how risk manifests and propagates. Economic value, operational authority, and reputational exposure increasingly concentrate in individuals whose digital identities act as aggregation points for data, relationships, and technical traces. As a result, risk that was once mediated primarily through systems and organizations now frequently originates at the level of the person. This paper introduces Identity Risk Governance (IRG), a framework developed by LeyesX for mapping, measuring, and governing risk associated with individual digital identity. IRG treats identity as a form of critical infrastructure and establishes a structured approach to managing exposure across open, behavioral, structural, deep web, dark web, and narrative domains. The framework is composed of three core elements. The Dark Exposure Index (DXI) provides a scalar metric for assessing proximity to actionable compromise. The TRIPLE S Protocol defines the operational logic of governance through Stealth (exposure reduction), Strike (incident reconstruction and intervention via the Attack Vector Reconstruction Protocol), and Stability (post-incident narrative continuity). Supporting analytical mechanisms enable continuous reassessment of identity risk over time. IRG is designed for environments in which individual identities anchor disproportionate economic and operational value, including creator economies, ultra-high-net-worth and family office ecosystems, Web3 and crypto markets, and reputationally sensitive digital industries. The framework offers a repeatable, governance-oriented model for managing the Human Attack Surface as a distinct risk domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了身份风险治理（IRG）框架，用于管理个人数字身份相关的风险。IRG将身份视为关键基础设施，通过暗网暴露指数（DXI）和TRIPLE S协议等工具，在开放、行为、结构、深网、暗网和叙事六个领域系统性地映射、测量和治理身份风险。
AI.research_question: 在数字经济中，当经济价值、运营权威和声誉风险日益集中于个人数字身份时，如何系统性地映射、测量和治理与个人数字身份相关的风险？
AI.motivation: 数字化改变了风险的呈现和传播方式。经济价值、运营权威和声誉风险日益集中于个人数字身份，这些身份成为数据、关系和技术痕迹的聚合点。原本主要通过系统和组织调节的风险，现在常常起源于个人层面，需要新的治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份风险治理（IRG）框架，将身份视为关键基础设施，在六个领域管理风险：开放、行为、结构、深网、暗网和叙事。包含暗网暴露指数（DXI）作为量化指标，TRIPLE S协议作为治理逻辑。
AI.method: 开发了IRG框架，包含三个核心要素：1）暗网暴露指数（DXI）作为可操作妥协接近度的标量指标；2）TRIPLE S协议（隐身、打击、稳定）定义治理操作逻辑；3）支持性分析机制实现身份风险的持续重新评估。
AI.findings: IRG框架为管理人类攻击面提供了一个可重复的、治理导向的模型，适用于创作者经济、超高净值家庭办公室生态系统、Web3和加密市场以及声誉敏感的数字产业等环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将个人数字身份概念化为关键基础设施；2）提出身份风险治理（IRG）作为系统性框架；3）将人类攻击面确立为独立的风险领域；4）引入暗网暴露指数（DXI）作为量化测量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为组织提供了管理个人身份风险的结构化方法；2）TRIPLE S协议提供了具体的操作流程；3）攻击向量重建协议支持事件调查和干预；4）适用于多种高风险数字环境的具体治理模型。

detail.abstract: This paper explores the theoretical basis and empirical evidence for understanding the links between neoliberal policies and health inequalities in the Indian context. The pathways in which inequality generates population health outcomes remain a major source of dispute within social epidemiology and health economics. Virchow's philosophy, which undoubtedly galvanised thinking across the disciplines, emphasises how political-economic ideologies and income inequality shape the distribution of health and social problems. In this paper, we argue that the focus on health inequality, while important, understates the role of neoliberal discourses and practices in making sense of contemporary debates on health inequality. Many quantitative studies have demonstrated that more neoliberal countries have poorer health than do fewer neoliberal countries, but we rarely find comprehensive documentation of evidence in the Indian context. In light of the fast-changing political and social environment and policy priorities post-1990s in general and post-2014, this paper examines the impact of a rising share of private healthcare delivery on health inequalities. Using inequality in the under-five mortality rate (U5MR) as a health outcome and per capita NSDP, per capita public health expenditure, the share of private health care spending and the poverty ratio as indicators of neoliberal policies, through robust econometric assessment, we find that economic growth without poverty reduction and public health care spending increase health inequalities. The fixed effects model plots depicting the interaction effects of PCPHE and time on health inequality suggest that public health spending consistently has a negative association with health inequality. However, the period impact of PCPHE on reducing health inequality is declined over time. Random effects model plots that show the interaction effects of the share of private health care utilisation and time consistently show a positive association with health inequality. Our findings also suggest that a positive association exists between the poverty ratio and health inequality. We conclude that integrating understandings of neoliberalism into theorising about health inequality enriches the political economic and political demographic perspective of health. India must implement "post neoliberal" social and political economic policies to counter neoliberal models that emerged in the 1990s and rising social and health inequalities. Ending poverty and austerity towards public health spending are two key steps for reducing health inequalities.

detail.abstract: Crisis is best understood as a period of rapid, high-stakes decision-making under tight time constraints and heightened uncertainty. In these conditions, authorities and aid systems often adopt exceptional measures that expand discretion and weaken routine oversight, creating openings for corruption in emergency procurement, relief distribution, and access to protection and services. This chapter advances a core claim with direct policy implications: corruption is a crisis multiplier for gender equality. Across conflict crises, natural disasters, and economic shocks, crisis conditions heighten gender-based violence and coercion, vulnerability, exclusion, and protective enforcement gaps, and corruption amplifies each pathway by increasing gatekeeping power, raising informal “prices”, diverting scarce resources, and weakening accountability. We develop an integrative conceptual framework that explains how these mechanisms operate during the acute shock and persist into recovery, when corruption can be relocated rather than eliminated. Using brief illustrative cases, the chapter shows how similar dynamics recur across crisis types as they enter through different institutional arenas. We conclude by translating the framework into an operational integrity agenda for crisis governance: safeguards that remain active under exceptional measures, including gender-responsive integrity rules for emergency procurement and relief allocation, disaggregated monitoring of who receives benefits and on what terms, survivor-centered reporting and remedy channels, and oversight arrangements that can function when discretion expands.

detail.abstract: Historical experience and recent political developments demonstrate that active phases of armed conflicts, including protracted and recurrent ones, can often be halted through targeted diplomatic efforts and external mediation. However, ceasefires and even formally concluded political agreements typically represent only transitional states, remaining vulnerable to relapse due to misaligned incentives, asymmetric distributions of benefits and costs, and volatile domestic political conditions. This paper proposes Economic Guarantees of Security (EGS) as a post-agreement mechanism designed to secure previously achieved political outcomes. It is argued that the introduction of preformalized and automatically enforced economic consequences for violations of peace enables the transformation of political agreements into self-sustaining and contract-like equilibria. By fixing incentives ex ante, EGS reduce the likelihood of unilateral deviation and mitigate commitment problems that commonly undermine peace implementation. The paper outlines the conceptual logic of EGS, its institutional design principles, and potential pathways for practical implementation. It further examines the applicability of such mechanisms to a number of recent and ongoing regional conflicts, highlighting their role as a continuation of peacekeeping efforts rather than a substitute for diplomacy or traditional security instruments.

detail.abstract: Does increased labor market scarcity lead to more local demand for immigration enforcement? We answer this by evaluating the impact of the Great Recession on 287(g) partnerships that deputize local law enforcement to act as immigration enforcement agents. Using a difference-indifferences design, we find that commuting zones that experienced higher unemployment during the Great Recession were significantly more likely to express interest in and adopt local immigration enforcement partnerships. The results are concentrated among commuting zones with an above median share in pre-Recession immigrant population, workforce in the construction industry, and foreign born representation in routine manual occupations. Our results are consistent with the hypothesis that adverse labor market shocks lead to greater support of policies restricting immigrants ability to compete in local labor markets.

detail.title: Beyond lockdowns: work-from-home, mental health, and the moderating roles of intensity, job control and social support
detail.abstract: During and shortly after the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, concerns were expressed that working from home (WFH) was creating a ‘mental health crisis’. Australia experienced a three-phase ‘WFH experiment’, with widespread high-intensity WFH imposed by lockdowns in 2020, deepened restrictions in 2021, and a transition to flexible work arrangements and more autonomy in 2022 as vaccination rates increased. Using data from the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia survey, this study estimates the impact of WFH on worker mental health across these phases. Findings show that WFH led to a modest, statistically significant deterioration in average worker mental health outcomes during the lockdown years (2020–2021), particularly among women. Negative effects were present in workers across the social support and job control spectrum, suggesting limited buffering capacity to counter the stress of lockdown restrictions. However, by 2022, the negative effects of WFH dissipated with positive effects for those WFH 25-50% of time, indicating that pandemic-related lockdowns, rather than WFH itself, were primarily responsible for mental health declines. The exception was workers with low job control, and females with dependents, who continued to experience negative effects, highlighting that job autonomy and unequal caregiving responsibilities may shape longer-term wellbeing outcomes.

detail.abstract: In this introduction to the Handbook of Chinese Entrepreneurship, we provide an overview of state capitalism and varieties of capitalism to explain the various forms of state intervention in the economy. Using the overview as a context, we also provide a summary of the debate on the distinct features of the Chinese model of state capitalism in the literature. detail.abstract: This study is the first to evaluate the performance of Euro government bond mutual funds with characteristic-based benchmarks. This analysis is based on the security-level holdings of the affected countries in the Euro sovereign debt crisis, i.e., the so-called periphery countries of Southern Europe, including Greece, Italy, Portugal, and Spain (GIPS). The combined contribution of bond selection and timing casts doubt on the value of active management relative to its costs. The results also show that the reinforced home bias after the Euro sovereign debt crisis resulted in assorted management skills across these markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次使用基于特征的基准评估欧元区政府债券共同基金的表现，聚焦于欧元主权债务危机中的南欧外围国家（希腊、意大利、葡萄牙、西班牙）。研究发现主动管理的价值相对于其成本值得怀疑，且危机后强化的本土偏好导致不同市场间的管理技能存在差异。
AI.research_question: 欧元区政府债券共同基金在欧元主权债务危机期间的表现如何？主动管理相对于其成本是否创造价值？危机后的本土偏好如何影响基金管理技能？
AI.motivation: 首次使用基于特征的基准评估欧元区政府债券基金表现；关注欧元主权债务危机这一重要金融事件；研究主动管理在危机环境下的价值；探讨本土偏好对基金表现的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主动基金管理理论；基于特征的基准评估方法；本土偏好理论；债券选择和择时能力评估框架。
AI.method: 使用证券层面的持仓数据；聚焦欧元主权债务危机中的南欧外围国家（GIPS）；采用基于特征的基准评估方法；分析债券选择和择时能力的综合贡献。
AI.findings: 1. 债券选择和择时的综合贡献对主动管理的价值提出质疑；2. 欧元主权债务危机后强化的本土偏好导致不同市场间的管理技能存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将基于特征的基准应用于欧元区政府债券基金评估；2. 提供了危机环境下主动管理价值的新证据；3. 发展了本土偏好与基金管理技能关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者评估欧元区债券基金提供新的评估框架；2. 质疑主动管理在危机环境下的成本效益；3. 揭示本土偏好对基金表现的影响，为投资决策提供参考。

title: Global Supply Chain Asymmetries and the Effectiveness of Environmental Regulations
affiliations: University of Hyogo, Kanto Gakuin University and Fukui Prefectural University

detail.title: Global Supply Chain Asymmetries and the Effectiveness of Environmental Regulations
detail.abstract: This study theoretically examines how asymmetries in global supply chains affect the effectiveness of environmental regulations using a two-country firm-heterogeneity model that features vertical integration of production processes and cross-border pollution. We show that: (1) the effects of emission standards differ between upstream and downstream segments of global supply chains, with upstream regulations possibly generating within-supply-chain carbon leakage; (2) under supply-chain disruptions, stricter-than-usual upstream regulations are required to reduce global emissions, whereas downstream regulations become more effective than in normal times; and (3) internationally coordinated regulations are not always effective in reducing global emissions, and their efficacy depends on the ex-ante level of regulation. Thus, governments should carefully assess pollution across cross-border supply chains and strategically choose where (upstream or downstream) and when (the timing of implementation) to regulate, as the effectiveness of environmental policies and international coordination can differ significantly from those under symmetric global supply chains in normal times.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两国企业异质性模型，探讨全球供应链不对称性如何影响环境规制效果。研究发现：1）排放标准对供应链上下游影响不同，上游规制可能导致供应链内碳泄漏；2）供应链中断时，需要更严格的上游规制来减少全球排放，而下游规制比平时更有效；3）国际协调规制并非总能减少全球排放，其效果取决于事前规制水平。
AI.research_question: 全球供应链的不对称性如何影响环境规制的有效性？
AI.motivation: 传统环境规制研究多假设对称的全球供应链，但现实中供应链存在显著不对称性（如上下游位置、跨国污染等），这些不对称性可能影响环境政策效果，需要理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两国企业异质性模型，包含生产过程的垂直整合和跨境污染特征。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，使用两国企业异质性模型，考察供应链垂直整合和跨境污染的影响。
AI.findings: 1）排放标准对供应链上下游影响不同，上游规制可能导致供应链内碳泄漏；2）供应链中断时，需要更严格的上游规制来减少全球排放，下游规制比平时更有效；3）国际协调规制并非总能减少全球排放，效果取决于事前规制水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统分析供应链不对称性对环境规制效果的影响；2）揭示了供应链内碳泄漏机制；3）阐明了供应链中断时期环境政策的特殊动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）政府应评估跨境供应链污染分布；2）需战略选择规制位置（上游或下游）和实施时机；3）国际协调需考虑供应链不对称性和事前规制水平。

title: A Note on Gamma-Vanna-Volga Volatility Interpolation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Note on Gamma-Vanna-Volga Volatility Interpolation
detail.abstract: The Gamma-Vanna-Volga model of Arslan, Eid, El Khoury and Roth is generalized to incorporate level dependent volatility of implied volatility and strike dependent correlation between implied volatility and the price process. The enhancement results in a five parameter model, which is two more than the original model. The five parameter model preserves the attractive features of the original Gamma-Vanna-Volga model whilst at the same time giving it additional flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Gamma-Vanna-Volga模型，增加了隐含波动率的水平依赖性和隐含波动率与价格过程的敲定价格相关性，形成五参数模型，比原模型多两个参数，在保持原模型优点的同时增加了灵活性。
AI.research_question: 如何将Gamma-Vanna-Volga模型扩展以包含隐含波动率的水平依赖性和隐含波动率与价格过程的敲定价格相关性？
AI.motivation: 原Gamma-Vanna-Volga模型虽然具有吸引力，但缺乏对隐含波动率水平依赖性和敲定价格相关性的建模能力，需要扩展以增强模型的灵活性和现实拟合能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Arslan、Eid、El Khoury和Roth提出的Gamma-Vanna-Volga模型框架，引入隐含波动率的水平依赖性和敲定价格相关性理论。
AI.method: 通过数学扩展方法，在原三参数Gamma-Vanna-Volga模型基础上增加两个参数，构建五参数模型。
AI.findings: 成功构建了五参数Gamma-Vanna-Volga模型，该模型保持了原模型的优点，同时增加了对隐含波动率水平依赖性和敲定价格相关性的建模能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了包含隐含波动率水平依赖性的扩展模型；2. 引入了敲定价格相关性参数；3. 建立了更灵活的期权定价框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融从业者提供更精确的期权定价工具；2. 增强了对市场波动率微笑和偏斜的建模能力；3. 提高了风险管理中对复杂波动率结构的捕捉能力。

title: When Co-location Misleads: Uncovering How Transport Access Reduces Deprivation Working Paper

detail.title: When Co-location Misleads: Uncovering How Transport Access Reduces Deprivation Working Paper

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Since transport access determines who can reach jobs, education, healthcare, and community life, governments increasingly use accessibility improvements to reduce deprivation and tackle social exclusion. Yet whether better access causally reduces disadvantage remains uncertain because observational analyses struggle to separate cause from context, and because accessibility itself can be measured in many, non-equivalent ways. Two challenges follow: (i) widely used measures of accessibility, cumulativeopportunity, gravity, and random-utility yield conflicting maps of accessibility and; (ii) estimates from observational data are vulnerable to confounding. This paper conducts a London-wide assessment that (a) compares widely used accessibility metrics, and (b) applies instrumental-variables (IV) estimation with road-safety-based instruments to address confounding and identify the causal effect of accessibility on deprivation. Using neighbourhood-scale accessibility and the 2019 Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD, proxies deprivation, and more broadly, social exclusion), we report two main findings. First, different accessibility measures produce very different maps of access. Choosing one over another can substantially change how patterns of accessibility are represented, although each constitutes a valuable characterisation of accessibility. Second, simple correlations suggest that accessibility and deprivation co-locate, whereas causal estimates indicate a consistent, directionally beneficial effect: improvement in accessibility leads to lower deprivation, with magnitudes differing across IMD domains. The implications from a policy perspective are clear: anchor transport investments in causal evidence rather than single metrics or simple correlations, and report results across conceptually distinct measures, so that accessibility improvements most plausibly reduce multidimensional disadvantage and social exclusion.

AI.tldr: 本文通过伦敦范围的评估，比较了不同的可达性度量方法，并应用工具变量估计来识别可达性对贫困的因果效应。研究发现：不同可达性度量会产生差异显著的地图；因果分析显示可达性改善确实能降低贫困，而简单相关性可能误导结论。
AI.research_question: 1) 不同可达性度量方法（累积机会、重力模型、随机效用模型）如何影响可达性地图的表示？2) 可达性改善是否对减少贫困和社会排斥具有因果效应？
AI.motivation: 政府越来越多地使用可达性改善来减少贫困和应对社会排斥，但可达性是否真正因果性地减少劣势仍不确定，因为观测性分析难以区分因果关系和背景因素，且可达性本身有多种非等效的测量方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可达性理论（包括累积机会、重力模型、随机效用模型等不同度量方法）；社会排斥理论；因果推断理论（工具变量方法）
AI.method: 伦敦范围的评估研究：1) 比较广泛使用的可达性度量方法；2) 应用工具变量估计，使用基于道路安全的工具变量来解决混杂问题，识别可达性对贫困的因果效应。使用邻里尺度的可达性数据和2019年多重贫困指数(IMD)。
AI.findings: 1) 不同可达性度量方法产生差异显著的可达性地图，选择不同度量会显著改变可达性模式的表示方式；2) 简单相关性显示可达性与贫困共现，而因果估计表明一致的方向性有益效应：可达性改善导致贫困降低，效应大小在IMD不同维度上存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统比较了不同可达性度量方法的差异和影响；2) 首次应用工具变量方法识别可达性对贫困的因果效应；3) 为可达性研究的度量选择和因果推断提供了方法论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 政策制定者应将交通投资基于因果证据而非单一度量或简单相关性；2) 应报告概念上不同度量的结果，使可达性改善最有可能减少多维劣势和社会排斥；3) 为城市规划和交通政策提供了实证依据。

title: Boardroom Observers: White Knight or Trojan Horse?
affiliations: University of Rhode Island and

detail.title: Boardroom Observers: White Knight or Trojan Horse?
detail.abstract: We investigate the governance implications of activist-appointed board observers, a non-voting alternative to directorship. Using Schedule 13D filings by activist blockholders, we study market reactions and subsequent firm outcomes associated with observer arrangements. Observer disclosures are accompanied by significantly negative abnormal returns relative to comparable activism without observers. Using an instrumental variable based on regional litigation risk, we establish a causal link. Also, observer presence is followed by a lower likelihood of the target being acquired, a higher likelihood of liquidation, and longer-term declines in firm performance. Overall, board observer roles appear to signal constrained oversight and limited strategic influence.

AI.tldr: 研究激进投资者任命的董事会观察员（无投票权的董事替代方案）的治理影响。发现观察员安排伴随显著负向异常回报，且导致目标公司被收购可能性降低、清算可能性增加、长期业绩下滑，表明观察员角色意味着受限的监督和有限的战略影响力。
AI.research_question: 激进投资者任命的董事会观察员（无投票权的董事替代方案）对公司治理和市场反应有何影响？
AI.motivation: 激进投资者通常通过获取董事会席位来影响公司治理，但董事会观察员作为一种无投票权的替代方案，其治理影响尚未得到充分研究。了解这种非传统治理机制的效果对投资者、公司和管理层具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、代理理论、激进投资者干预理论、董事会监督有效性理论
AI.method: 使用激进投资者大股东提交的Schedule 13D文件数据，研究观察员安排的市场反应和后续公司结果。采用基于地区诉讼风险的工具变量方法建立因果关系。
AI.findings: 1. 观察员披露伴随显著负向异常回报（相比无观察员的激进干预）；2. 观察员存在导致目标公司被收购可能性降低；3. 清算可能性增加；4. 长期公司业绩下滑；5. 观察员角色信号受限的监督和有限的战略影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究董事会观察员这一非传统治理机制的影响；2. 扩展了激进投资者干预的理论框架；3. 揭示了无投票权监督机制的有效性限制；4. 为董事会监督理论提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助投资者评估激进投资者干预策略的有效性；2. 为公司管理层提供应对激进投资者的策略参考；3. 为监管机构理解非传统治理安排提供依据；4. 帮助市场参与者更准确解读激进投资者行为信号。

title: Monetary Policy, Bank Leverage and Systemic Risk-Taking
affiliations: University of Tokyo, Banco de España and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Monetary Policy, Bank Leverage and Systemic Risk-Taking

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2517
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the interplay between monetary policy, bank risk-taking, and financial stability in a quantitative macroeconomic model with endogenous risk-taking by banks and systemic crises. Banks’ access to leverage depends on their charter value, which is itself affected by movements in the real interest rate. We find that permanent shifts in the long-term real interest rate have a significant impact on banks’ leverage and on their investments in systemically risky assets, while transitory movements have a more limited impact. We show that in the presence of systemic risk-taking, the systemic component of monetary policy faces a trade-off between price stability and financial stability. A moderate reaction to inflation deviations from the target is optimal, as it sustains banks’ equity value after financial crises. Seeking price stability reduces inflation volatility but leads to increased systemic risk-taking and more severe financial recessions. The optimal central bank policy combination involves an increase in regulatory bank capital requirements coupled with a moderate reaction of monetary policy to inflation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了货币政策、银行风险承担和金融稳定之间的相互作用。研究发现，长期实际利率的永久性变化对银行杠杆和系统性风险资产投资有显著影响，而暂时性变化影响有限。在系统性风险存在的情况下，货币政策面临价格稳定与金融稳定的权衡。最优政策组合包括提高银行资本监管要求，同时货币政策对通胀采取适度反应。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何影响银行风险承担和金融稳定？在存在系统性风险承担的情况下，货币政策面临怎样的权衡？最优的货币政策和监管政策组合是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策、银行风险承担和金融稳定之间的复杂关系对于制定有效的宏观审慎政策至关重要。特别是在系统性风险存在的情况下，货币政策需要在价格稳定和金融稳定之间做出权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内生银行风险承担和系统性危机的定量宏观经济模型。银行获得杠杆的能力取决于其特许权价值，而特许权价值又受实际利率变动的影响。
AI.method: 使用包含内生银行风险承担和系统性危机的定量宏观经济模型进行分析。模型考虑了银行杠杆、特许权价值、实际利率变动和系统性风险资产投资之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 长期实际利率的永久性变化对银行杠杆和系统性风险资产投资有显著影响，而暂时性变化影响有限；2. 在系统性风险存在的情况下，货币政策面临价格稳定与金融稳定的权衡；3. 追求价格稳定会降低通胀波动，但会增加系统性风险承担和金融衰退的严重程度；4. 对通胀偏离目标的适度反应是最优的，因为能在金融危机后维持银行股权价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了货币政策、银行风险承担和金融稳定之间相互作用的定量理论框架；2. 揭示了长期实际利率变化对银行风险承担的不同影响机制；3. 提出了在系统性风险存在情况下货币政策面临的价格稳定与金融稳定的权衡理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中央银行提供了最优政策组合建议：提高银行资本监管要求，同时货币政策对通胀采取适度反应；2. 强调了宏观审慎政策与货币政策协调的重要性；3. 为政策制定者在价格稳定和金融稳定之间做出权衡提供了实证依据。

title: Hard to Process: Atypical Firms and the Cross-Section of Expected Stock Returns

detail.title: Hard to Process: Atypical Firms and the Cross-Section of Expected Stock Returns
detail.abstract: Theories of limited attention predict that investors rely on typical patterns to navigate high-dimensional firm information, making atypical firms hard to process. To quantify this difficulty, we propose a data-driven measure of how atypical a firm's combination of characteristics is using an autoencoder (ATYP). The model learns the typical patterns that describe most firms, and ATYP aggregates the deviations those patterns cannot explain. Unlike measures of disclosure or organizational complexity, ATYP captures the processing difficulty of the underlying information. Empirically, we document that ATYP strongly predicts future returns. A decile portfolio that sells high-ATYP firms and buys low-ATYP firms earns 1.47% per month (equal-weighted) and 0.82% (value-weighted). The effect strengthens precisely where investor attention is low and arbitrage is limited, suggesting mispricing driven by limited information processing.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于自编码器的数据驱动方法（ATYP）来衡量公司特征组合的非典型性，发现非典型性越高的公司未来收益越低，表明投资者因有限注意力而难以处理非典型信息，导致错误定价。
AI.research_question: 公司特征组合的非典型性如何影响投资者信息处理难度和资产定价？
AI.motivation: 有限注意力理论认为投资者依赖典型模式处理高维公司信息，非典型公司难以处理，但缺乏量化这种处理难度的客观方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限注意力理论（Limited Attention Theory），投资者信息处理约束，行为金融学中的错误定价机制。
AI.method: 使用自编码器（autoencoder）构建ATYP指标，学习描述大多数公司的典型模式，并汇总这些模式无法解释的偏差。通过投资组合分析和横截面回归检验ATYP对未来收益的预测能力。
AI.findings: ATYP强烈预测未来收益：卖出高ATYP公司、买入低ATYP公司的十分位投资组合每月获得1.47%（等权重）和0.82%（市值权重）的超额收益。在投资者注意力低、套利受限的环境中效应更强。

title: Asset Risk and Bank Runs
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Rotterdam School of Management (RSM) and Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Finance

detail.title: Asset Risk and Bank Runs
detail.abstract: We analyze how the likelihood of bank-runs depends on bank asset risk. We introduce a Global Games-based bank-run model with balance sheet equity and risky assets. Elevated asset risk increases the probability of fundamentals-based bankruptcy and thereby may trigger bank-runs. However, elevated asset risk also induces higher returns in good states. These returns create additional loss absorption capacity and thereby lower the probability of non-fundamental bankruptcy. This in turn lowers the likelihood of bank-runs. The latter effect dominates when marginal benefits of capital are high (i.e., when banks are poorly capitalized).

AI.tldr: 本文通过全球博弈模型分析银行资产风险如何影响挤兑概率。研究发现，资产风险增加会提高基本面破产概率，从而可能引发挤兑；但同时高风险资产在良好状态下带来更高回报，增强了损失吸收能力，降低了非基本面破产概率。当银行资本充足率较低时，后一种效应占主导地位。
AI.research_question: 银行资产风险如何影响银行挤兑的可能性？
AI.motivation: 理解银行挤兑的驱动因素对金融稳定至关重要。现有研究多关注存款保险、流动性等因素，但对资产风险如何影响挤兑概率的研究不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，分析资产风险通过不同机制对挤兑概率的复杂影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球博弈理论（Global Games）的银行挤兑模型，结合资产负债表权益和风险资产。该框架允许分析资产风险通过基本面破产和非基本面破产两种渠道对挤兑概率的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建全球博弈模型分析银行资产风险与挤兑概率的关系。模型包含银行资产负债表、风险资产回报分布、存款人策略选择等要素，通过均衡分析推导挤兑概率的决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 资产风险增加会提高基本面破产概率，从而可能增加挤兑风险；2. 但资产风险增加也带来更高潜在回报，增强了银行的损失吸收能力，降低了非基本面破产概率；3. 当银行资本充足率较低时，后一种效应（损失吸收能力增强）占主导地位，反而降低了挤兑概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在全球博弈框架中系统分析资产风险对挤兑概率的双重影响机制；2. 揭示了资产风险通过基本面和非基本面破产渠道对挤兑概率的复杂作用；3. 提出了资本充足率在调节资产风险-挤兑关系中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行风险管理提供新视角：高风险资产不一定总是增加挤兑风险；2. 为监管政策提供启示：资本充足率要求应与资产风险特性相匹配；3. 帮助理解金融危机中银行挤兑的动态机制。

title: Reevaluating Causal Estimation Methods with Data from a Product Release
affiliations: Microsoft Corporation - Microsoft Research New England, Microsoft Corp. and Microsoft Corp.

detail.title: Reevaluating Causal Estimation Methods with Data from a Product Release
detail.abstract: Recent developments in causal machine learning methods have made it easier to estimate flexible relationships between confounders, treatments and outcomes, making unconfoundedness assumptions in causal analysis more palatable. How successful are these approaches in recovering ground truth baselines? In this paper we analyze a new data sample including an experimental rollout of a new feature at a large technology company and a simultaneous sample of users who endogenously opted into the feature. We find that recovering ground truth causal effects is feasible-but only with careful modeling choices. Our results build on the observational causal literature beginning with LaLonde (1986), offering best practices for more credible treatment effect estimation in modern, high-dimensional datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析一家大型科技公司的新功能实验数据，发现虽然现代因果机器学习方法可以恢复真实因果效应，但需要谨慎的建模选择才能实现。
AI.research_question: 现代因果机器学习方法在恢复真实基准因果效应方面有多成功？
AI.motivation: 因果机器学习方法的发展使得估计混淆变量、处理和结果之间的灵活关系变得更加容易，但需要验证这些方法在实际应用中恢复真实因果效应的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于LaLonde（1986）开创的观测因果文献，结合现代高维数据集中的因果推断理论。
AI.method: 分析一家大型科技公司的新功能实验数据，包括实验性推出组和同时期内生选择使用该功能的用户样本。
AI.findings: 恢复真实因果效应是可行的，但只有在谨慎的建模选择下才能实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 为现代高维数据集中更可信的处理效应估计提供了最佳实践指南，扩展了观测因果文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和从业者在实际应用中应用因果机器学习方法提供了具体指导，强调了建模选择对结果准确性的重要性。

title: Low-income mothers’ mental health and residential satisfaction: How do they connect housing hardship and parenting practices?
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Kyung Hee University, , University of London and

detail.title: Low-income mothers’ mental health and residential satisfaction: How do they connect housing hardship and parenting practices?
detail.abstract: In this study, we examine the relationship between housing hardship and parenting behaviors based on cross-sectional data from 777 low-income mothers with preschool children in Hong Kong. Drawing on the ecology of parenting framework, multiple linear regression models revealed indoor housing quality problems to be positively associated with aggressive parenting (measured by how often children were disciplined physically, or hit), after adjusting for the mothers’ and families’ socioeconomic conditions. Path analyses found that housing hardship increases maternal mental health problems, leading to aggressive parenting and residential dissatisfaction, further reducing the mothers’ engagement in daily parenting activities with their preschoolers. Our findings provide evidence of the effects of housing attributes and identify the salient influence of residential satisfaction on parenting styles in socioeconomically disadvantaged families. They also underscore the importance of addressing housing conditions in interventions aimed at improving parenting and, ultimately, child well-being.

detail.abstract: A comprehensive search was conducted across multiple databases (ABI/INFORM, EBSCO, EconLit, PubMed, PsycNet, Scopus and Web of Science) to scope the literature surrounding impact of economic interventions on common mental disorders or suicide among rural workforce in Low-and-Middle-Income-Countries (LMICs). 69 eligible studies were reviewed that highlight low representation from low-income countries coupled with inequitable geographical representation with 72% studies from six LMICs including 45% from China. Divergence and heterogeneity in findings across interventions and context calls for identifying the active ingredients for mental health through mechanisms of change. 65% studies did not discuss the duration of impact of an intervention, which could be transitory and short-lived that might have potential implications for translational research and policy perspective.

title: Commercial Large Language Models in Clinical Practice: A Governance Framework for Use-Bound, Adaptive Integration

detail.title: Commercial Large Language Models in Clinical Practice: A Governance Framework for Use-Bound, Adaptive Integration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Commercial large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT are entering clinical workflows faster than any prior digital technology. Although developed as general-purpose conversational systems, their accessibility, fluency, and broad knowledge base have made them attractive to clinicians for tasks ranging from documentation and patient communication to diagnostic brainstorming. This rapid diffusion, however, has occurred largely outside formal institutional oversight, regulatory classification, or established accountability structures. As a result, a growing pattern of informal and unsanctioned use has emerged within healthcare systems. This paper argues that informal clinician adoption of LLMs is not merely a product of regulatory lag or individual experimentation, but reflects a deeper structural mismatch between how healthcare governance is designed to regulate diagnostic technologies and how general-purpose AI systems are built, updated, and deployed. Existing regulatory and institutional frameworks presuppose tools that are domain-specific, stable, versioned, and tied to clearly defined intended uses. Commercial LLMs violate each of these assumptions: they operate as open-domain generalists, evolve continuously through opaque updates, and lack clinically meaningful boundaries or validation pathways. Drawing on empirical evidence of emerging clinical use and established regulatory models such as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and the FDA's Predetermined Change Control Plan, this paper proposes an adapted governance framework for clinical LLM integration. The framework is structured around four principles: use-based boundaries, adaptive oversight, institution-centered responsibility, and distributed accountability. Together, these principles provide a foundation for governing general-purpose AI systems in ways that better align with the realities of clinical practice while preserving patient safety, professional accountability, and public trust.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨商业大语言模型在临床工作流程中的非正式使用现象，指出现有医疗监管框架与通用AI系统特性之间的结构性不匹配，并提出适应性的治理框架。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗技术监管理论（如医疗器械软件SaMD框架、FDA预定变更控制计划），分析通用AI系统与医疗监管框架的结构性不匹配。
AI.method: 结合新兴临床使用经验证据和既有监管模型分析，提出适应性治理框架。
AI.findings: 现有监管框架假设工具是领域特定、稳定、版本化且与明确定义用途绑定的，而商业LLM违反所有这些假设：它们是开放领域的通用系统、通过不透明更新持续演化、缺乏临床意义边界或验证路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于识别医疗监管框架与通用AI系统特性之间的结构性不匹配，提出适应性治理理论框架，扩展医疗技术监管理论以适应AI时代。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出基于四大原则的临床LLM整合治理框架：基于使用的边界、适应性监督、机构中心责任、分布式问责，为医疗机构、监管机构和政策制定者提供实用指导。

detail.abstract: The evolving landscape of Islamic unity and approximation efforts requires a strategic and measurable approach to overcome sectarian differences and promote collaboration. This paper presents a comprehensive Key Performance Indicator (KPI) framework tailored to Islamic unity and approximation initiatives, addressing various dimensions such as educational programs, political collaboration, conflict resolution, and community engagement. Through a datadriven, KPI-based approach, Islamic organizations can systematically monitor and evaluate the progress of their approximation efforts, ensuring accountability, transparency, and long-term sustainability. The paper explores the significance of KPIs in fostering intersect collaboration, religious tolerance, and social cohesion across the global Islamic community. By showcasing best practices from successful initiatives and offering actionable insights, this research provides a roadmap for religious scholars, leaders, and institutions to enhance unity efforts using structured and strategic measurements. The findings highlight the potential of KPIs to transform traditional unity programs into impactful, scalable, and enduring initiatives that address contemporary challenges faced by the Islamic world.

title: Forward-Looking vs Reverse Geopolitical Stress Testing: What Boards Need to Know
affiliations: Central Bank of Bahrain

detail.title: Forward-Looking vs Reverse Geopolitical Stress Testing: What Boards Need to Know
detail.abstract: Geopolitical risk captures the possibility that wars, sanctions, cyberattacks, and abrupt shifts in international relations disrupt macro-financial conditions, impair asset values, and threaten cross-border business models. Banks traditionally manage this risk through country and sector limits, sanctions-sensitivity caps, and qualitative "red lines" in risk appetite frameworks, increasingly linked to heat maps, early-warning indicators, and stress-testing outputs. Forward-looking and reverse stress tests offer complementary ways to assess how such shocks could undermine capital, liquidity, and business-model viability. Forward-looking geopolitical stress tests start from "severe but plausible" scenarios, embedding deglobalization, trade fragmentation, energy shocks, and cyber risks into macro-financial paths that are then mapped into credit, market, operational, and funding metrics within ICAAP/ILAAP and regulatory stress tests. Reverse geopolitical stress tests invert this logic, starting from a defined failure outcome (for example, a 300-basis-point CET1 depletion or non-viability) and working backwards to identify the bank-specific geopolitical constellations and channels that could produce it, including second-round and feedback effects. Recent regulatory initiatives, such as the ECB's 2026 proposed thematic reverse stress test on geopolitical risk exemplifies this shift, requiring 110 directly supervised banks to design their own scenarios that meet an outcome constraint, integrate them into ICAAP, and use the results to strengthen internal stress-testing, governance, and risk data aggregation. While the exercise will not directly set Pillar 2 capital guidance, supervisors intend to use findings qualitatively in SREP to challenge business models, risk appetite, and recovery planning under radical geopolitical uncertainty. In this backdrop, the present paper discusses how banks should use both forward-looking and reverse stress testing to understand and manage geopolitical risk across capital, liquidity, and business-model dimensions. The paper stresses the role of stress tests in geopolitical risk assessment, looking at the synergies of conventional and reverse stress tests. It emphasizes the qualitative use of reverse stress test in SREP to test banks' governance, risk appetite, recovery planning, and internal stress-testing capabilities rather than to impose direct capital add-ons. It concludes that boards should treat forward-looking and reverse approaches as complementary tools that jointly inform risk appetite calibration, recovery options, strategic repositioning, and supervisory dialogue in an era of heightened geopolitical uncertainty.

detail.title: Consumer xenocentrism in the majority world: Eco-anxiety mediates the effect of green consumption values and the fear of missing out on consumer xenocentrism in Ecuador
detail.abstract: As sustainability awareness grows, international companies have identified a trend of consumers seeking sustainable foreign products; therefore, they have integrated sustainable communication into their marketing strategies to convey these characteristics and influence consumer xenocentrism, which is the preference for foreign products. The use of sustainable communication can lead to eco-anxiety; hence, it becomes relevant to consider its influence on consumers who depict FOMO and green values. This study examines whether eco-anxiety mediates the effect of (a) the fear of missing out and (b) green consumption values on consumer xenocentrism. A total of 374 usable surveys were gathered from a sample of Ecuadorian consumers, and the study utilized Covariance-Structural Equation Modelling for data analysis. The findings indicate that eco-anxiety has an indirect effect across both these constructs, ultimately shaping consumer xenocentrism responses. This insight deepens our understanding of why consumers beyond Western, educated, industrialized, rich, and democratic (WEIRD) societies favor foreign products, emphasizing the role of sustainable communication in influencing consumer perceptions toward these products.

detail.abstract: The Contemporary Theory of Digitalization (CToD) seeks to explain digitalization not merely as the adoption of digital technologies, but as a comprehensive, systemic, and evolving transformation that reshapes how organizations function internally and how they interact with other organizations across global networks. CToD provides a logical and conceptual framework that helps organizations to understand, design, govern, and sustain digital transformation in a rapidly changing technological, economic, and social environment. The theory recognizes digitalization as a multidimensional phenomenon involving technology, people, processes, institutions, and power relations rather than a purely technical upgrade. The innovation of CToD lies in its three-level structure, which reflects increasing degrees of digital maturity and complexity. Level 1 is a foundational digital order, whereas Level 2 is an operational digitalization, and Level 3 is Digital Connectivity and Global Interaction. This layered approach allows scholars and practitioners to analyze digitalization systematically, identify weaknesses, and design targeted interventions. It also facilitates empirical testing and comparative analysis across sectors and jurisdictions.

title: Uneven Modernization in the Muslim World

detail.title: Uneven Modernization in the Muslim World
detail.abstract: Modernization is a multidimensional process that enhances human welfare. The relative modernity levels of geographic units can be inferred from global migration patterns, which favor destinations offering opportunities deemed superior. On this basis, we introduce a migration-based "modernity index" and show that the Muslim World currently lags behind major recipient countries. The gap does not indicate stagnation. The Muslim World has been modernizing, though unevenly across time, regions, and sectors. Although existing research documents these variations, systematic analyses of differing paces and patterns of selective convergence remain scarce. This survey fills that gap by distinguishing among continuous, punctuated, and latent modernization trajectories and organizing the literature around four leading explanations for persistent developmental lags: collectivist attitudes, Islamic religious tenets, Islamic legal institutions, and colonial institutional legacies. The resulting framework highlights various sectoral contrasts, such as rapid progress in health and basic education alongside persistent deficits in political and religious liberties.

detail.abstract: This study advances a critical theory of sub-national political violence by proposing the “Architecture of Erasure”—a diagnostic framework for understanding the deliberate, three-decade marginalization of Somali Maeso Woreda in Ethiopia. Moving beyond critiques of state failure, it demonstrates how institutions of ethnic federalism are weaponized for territorial dispossession and political nullification. Employing an innovative “embodied structural forensics” methodology that integrates the author's firsthand testimony as a former official with archival, ethnographic, and policy analysis, the paper dissects this architecture through its core mechanisms: the political-territorial dismemberment via fraudulent referenda and rigged quotas; system maintenance through the instrumentalization of clan identity and a repressive playbook against local leadership; and the geopolitical weaponization of the territory into a zone of perpetual destabilization. The analysis concludes that this condition constitutes a form of internal settler colonialism, fundamentally challenging the emancipatory promise of ethnic federalism and providing a crucial evidence-based model for scholars and policymakers analyzing engineered conflict, disenfranchisement, and institutional violence in the Horn of Africa and comparable contexts.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了"抹除架构"框架，分析埃塞俄比亚索马里州Maeso Woreda地区30年来被系统性边缘化的过程，揭示民族联邦制如何被武器化用于领土剥夺和政治抹除。

AI.motivation: 超越对国家失败的批判，揭示民族联邦制如何被用于系统性边缘化和领土剥夺，填补对次国家政治暴力理解的理论空白。

title: Value Stream Revolution: Reconstructing The Three Worlds of Enterprises (Organizations) --Theoretical Construction, Tool Derivation, and Case Validation Based on the Three-System Model of Creation, Realization, and Support

detail.title: Value Stream Revolution: Reconstructing The Three Worlds of Enterprises (Organizations) --Theoretical Construction, Tool Derivation, and Case Validation Based on the Three-System Model of Creation, Realization, and Support
detail.abstract: Traditional organizational management theories are facing a severe "crisis of explanatory power" as digital transformation accelerates and the global market environment increasingly presents the characteristics of VUCA (volatility, uncertainty, complexity, ambiguity). This paper presents a paradigm reconfiguration based on "process dynamics" in response to the fundamental limitations of the "structural classification" paradigm in mainstream organizational theory-that is, the difficulty in effectively diagnosing chronic problems such as strategy-execution disconnection, departmental walls, and systemic synergy failure. This study disregards the traditional anatomical view of the enterprise as a static collection of functional departments (such as R&D, sales, finance), returns to the ontological origin of the existence of the enterprise, redefines it as a dynamic value stream system, regards the enterprise as a living entity centered around value generation and realization, and decomposes the core functions of the enterprise from this perspective as: Value generation, value realization, internal support, and systematic elaboration of the synergy logic driven by the "meta-mission". Based on this, this paper constructs the "value carrier Creation-value market Realization-internal Support" three-system model (C-M-S model). It reveals that the "C-M coupling degree" and the efficiency of the S system are key variables determining the performance and lifespan of the enterprise, and elaborates on the interaction mechanism of information flow, decision flow and incentive flow among the systems; Thirdly, a set of operationalized solutions from theory to practice was completed, and the diagnostic framework for the health and coupling of the three systems of the organization was developed. Through comparative analysis of actual cases, this framework not only reveals the pathology of "coupling mechanism breakdown" leading to decline, but also demonstrates that "coupling mechanism can be actively constructed and repaired" is at the core of successful organizational transformation. This study aims to provide a complete framework from theoretical construction, measurement blueprint to management intervention to drive organizational analysis from static structure to dynamic systems science.

title: Frequent Flyer Flagging - Proposed Model for Tracking Patterns of Lawyer Disciplinary Complaints

detail.title: Frequent Flyer Flagging - Proposed Model for Tracking Patterns of Lawyer Disciplinary Complaints

keywords: Model Rules For Lawyer Disciplinary Enforcement

detail.abstract:
The case of Thomas Girardi underscores the urgent need for reform in how grievances and patterns of misconduct are tracked. Over four decades, the California State Bar received and neglected more than 200 grievances against Girardi. It was only after his firm collapsed and criminal charges were filed that the Bar addressed the misconduct. Earlier intervention could have prevented the mishandling of eighteen million dollars and spared his clients from significant harm. This example of systemic oversight illustrates not only the imbalance of power between lawyers and clients, but also the tendency of disciplinary agencies to summarily dismiss most grievances at intake. 

Inspired by the Girardi case and subsequent California reform, this comment provides a novel approach to remedy the systemic weaknesses of the current discipline framework. It proposes implementing a “Frequent Flyer Flagging” system that uses complaint-pattern tracking to flag “frequent flyers” and provide timely notice of repeated misconduct. A frequent flyer is an attorney who receives an excessive number of grievances in a short period of time. Part I elaborates on the Girardi matter and its significance. Part II provides the background and explains the current regulatory framework. Part III recognizes and attempts to reconcile the competing interests of the public and the profession. In addition, this section recognizes the capabilities and limitations of a disciplinary intake office.

Part IV of this comment presents two models designed to identify and address patterns of excessive complaints. The models are fleshed out with options for phases, thresholds, and safeguards which can be tailored to complement each jurisdiction’s specific needs. Model A requires a flagged attorney to meet with disciplinary authorities to address the concerning pattern and to provide more information. If the board finds the prior dismissals were premature, it may reopen the files and resume the existing investigation process. Under Model B, subsequent complaints against a flagged attorney automatically proceed to investigation, bypassing the intake phase. The board should have discretion in deciding whether to advance the complaint or screen it out as a clearly frivolous matter. Both models preserve respondents’ due process rights while striking the proper balance between the parties’ interests.

By adopting a pattern-tracking system, disciplinary agencies can enhance accountability, protect the public, and restore confidence in the profession’s ability to self-regulate. To facilitate integration, this comment concludes by urging the ABA to conduct a comprehensive national review, issue updated reform recommendations, and to provide clearer guidance for intake and recordkeeping procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文针对律师纪律监管体系的系统性缺陷，提出"常客标记"系统，通过投诉模式追踪识别频繁被投诉的律师，以早期干预防止严重不当行为，平衡公众利益与律师权利。

AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 监管体系设计理论：平衡公众保护与律师权利；2) 行为模式识别理论：通过投诉频率识别风险模式；3) 程序正义理论：在提高监管效率的同时保障正当程序权利；4) 自我监管理论：法律职业自我监管的有效性改进。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析方法，基于案例研究（Girardi案）和比较分析（加州改革），提出两种具体的"常客标记"系统模型：模型A要求标记律师与监管机构会面讨论投诉模式；模型B使后续投诉自动进入调查阶段，绕过受理筛选。

title: Real Effects of Suppliers’ Environmental and Social Impact Disclosure

detail.title: Real Effects of Suppliers’ Environmental and Social Impact Disclosure
detail.abstract: We study how the disclosure of suppliers' environmental and social impacts affects production choices and engagement levels of two competing firms. In our setting, the suppliers' production generates a negative impact that reduces the firms' cash flows. However, this impact is mitigated if the firms engage with their suppliers. When the firms have distinct suppliers, a firm's production choice and its engagement level are substitutes for those of the competing firm. Disclosure of the supplier's impact disciplines the firms and always increases the firms' surplus. In contrast, when the firms share a common supplier, the firms' production choices and engagement levels are either substitutes or complements. While some disclosure of the supplier's impact disciplines the firms and leads to a larger surplus than no disclosure, full disclosure is not always beneficial. In particular, the firms may be worse off with full disclosure than with partial disclosure as full disclosure may result in insufficient engagement due to the complementarity of the firms' engagement levels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究供应商环境和社会影响披露如何影响两家竞争企业的生产选择和参与水平。当企业拥有不同供应商时，披露能约束企业行为并增加企业剩余；但当企业共享同一供应商时，完全披露可能因参与水平的互补性导致参与不足，反而不如部分披露。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论框架，分析两家竞争企业在不同供应商结构下的战略互动。考虑供应商生产产生的负外部性对企业现金流的影响，以及企业通过参与供应商活动来缓解这种影响的机制。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含两家竞争企业、供应商生产负外部性、企业参与水平等要素的博弈模型。分析不同披露制度（无披露、部分披露、完全披露）下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1. 当企业拥有独立供应商时，披露能约束企业行为，总是增加企业剩余；2. 当企业共享同一供应商时，企业的生产选择和参与水平可能是替代或互补关系；3. 完全披露不一定最优，可能因参与水平的互补性导致参与不足，使企业剩余低于部分披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了供应链结构在披露效果中的关键作用；2. 识别了共享供应商情境下企业参与水平的互补性机制；3. 挑战了"更多披露总是更好"的传统观点，提出了披露程度的最优选择问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业设计供应商披露政策提供指导：独立供应商结构适合完全披露，共享供应商结构需要谨慎选择披露程度；2. 为监管机构制定ESG披露标准提供理论依据；3. 帮助企业理解在不同供应链结构下如何平衡披露与参与决策。

detail.title: Buddhism and Economic Ethics: Integrating Spiritual Ideals with Material Reality
detail.abstract: This study examines the intersection of Buddhism and economic ethics, analyzing how Theravada and Mahayana traditions offer distinct yet complementary approaches to contemporary economic challenges. Employing a flexible integrated research methodology, the paper explores the philosophical foundations underlying Buddhist economic thought, tracing their origins to the Buddha's Middle Way, a balanced path that rejected both the extreme asceticism and materialistic hedonism prevalent in pre-Buddhist India. The fundamental distinction between the Theravada ideal of the Arahant (individual liberation) and the Mahayana ideal of the Bodhisattva (collective welfare) creates divergent economic philosophies: Theravada emphasizes personal ethical conduct, mindful consumption, and cautious engagement with wealth, while Mahayana promotes systemic transformation and the strategic use of wealth for societal benefit. Using Sri Lanka as a case study, the paper examines how a predominantly Theravada country displays economic behaviors increasingly aligned with Mahayana principles, creating a hybrid model that blends traditional spiritual values with modern capitalist practices. The analysis of the Sigalovada Sutta's fourfold division of wealth reveals both the enduring relevance and practical challenges of applying ancient Buddhist economic principles to contemporary issues including wealth inequality, consumerism, and globalization. The study concludes that integrating insights from both traditions offers pathways toward more compassionate, equitable, and sustainable economic systems.

title: Digital patient distribution as a disaster risk reduction measure in mass-casualty incidents Evidence from the Munich vehicle-ramming attack (2025)

detail.title: Digital patient distribution as a disaster risk reduction measure in mass-casualty incidents Evidence from the Munich vehicle-ramming attack (2025)
detail.abstract: Urban mass-casualty incidents (MCIs), particularly those resulting from deliberate attacks, pose a significant challenge to disaster risk reduction due to the risk of cascading system failures, hospital overload, and delayed definitive care. Digital coordination systems are increasingly recognized as key enablers of system resilience in such high-impact, low-frequency events.This study analyzes the emergency medical response to a vehicle-ramming attack in Munich, Germany, on February 13, 2025, which resulted in 39 casualties, including two fatalities. Using retrospective operational data from a web-based mass-casualty coordination module integrated into the regional hospital capacity management system, we evaluated system performance with respect to communication speed, dynamic capacity adaptation, and patient distribution. Early activation of the digital coordination system by the integrated emergency dispatch center enabled transparent, real-time situational awareness and demand-oriented patient allocation. All critically injured patients were distributed across multiple hospitals within 19 minutes, preventing local overload and maintaining routine emergency care capacity citywide. Continuous digital feedback from hospitals allowed dynamic adjustment of resources throughout the incident.Beyond its operational benefits, the system provided comprehensive documentation that supported post-incident evaluation and organizational learning. Identified areas for improvement primarily concerned structured in-system communication between dispatch centers and hospitals.These findings highlight the role of digital patient distribution platforms as resilience-enhancing tools in urban disaster response. Integrating such systems into routine emergency workflows, combined with standardized preparation and training, represents an effective strategy for disaster risk reduction and the mitigation of secondary system failures during MCIs.

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Organizational Analysis, volume 34, issue 12, 2026[10.1108/IJOA-11-2024-5000]

detail.abstract: Purpose-This conceptual paper aims to explore organisational operating rhythms with a view to establishing a broader understanding of how they might be experienced in relation to wellbeing or thriving at both the organisational and individual levels. A model of operating rhythms is proposed, which integrates systems theory concepts alongside a new conception of individual and contextual enablers of thriving. Design/methodology/approach-A literature review is conducted on temporal workplace processes with the addition of wellbeing and thriving related terminology. This review was then used to synthesise perspectives from organisational analysis and positive organisational scholarship, providing new conceptual frameworks for understanding organisational temporal experiences in relation to thriving. Findings-Identifying limited prior research on temporal rhythms in organisations and the relationship to thriving and wellbeing, a conceptual link between these variables is developed to encourage and support further research in this area. This proposed model includes systems theory perspectives and suggests that workplace rhythms shape the flow of information, feedback, learning and interpersonal interaction, influencing the conditions that support thriving. Implications of this conceptualisation of organisational temporal experience provide potential approaches for use within organisational contexts. Originality/value-Two novel contributions are introduced. Firstly, a two-axis model that maps organisational rhythms along a continuum from strategic to operational (Y-axis) and intentional to emergent (X-axis). Secondly, the concept of a zone of interaction, where personal and contextual enablers of thriving intersect, is proposed as a lens to understand complex variables that, including operating rhythms, influence lived workplace experience at micro and macro levels.

title: Fiscal Costs and Implementation Feasibility of Minimum Price Support Policies: A Scenario Analysis
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University and  ICAR- National Institute of Biotic Stress Management

detail.title: Fiscal Costs and Implementation Feasibility of Minimum Price Support Policies: A Scenario Analysis
detail.abstract: For policymakers concerned with farm income stability and national food security, the Minimum Support Price (MSP) remains a critical instrument. However, some farmers organisations demand of extending assured physical procurement beyond paddy and wheat to all 23 MSP-notified crops would impose substantial fiscal and operational pressures. This paper quantifies the fiscal consequences of alternative MSP implementation pathways for the 2024-25 marketing year to inform evidence-based policy choices. We evaluate three policy options: (i) partial physical procurement, (ii) a mixed approach with partial Price Deficiency Payments (PDP), and (iii) universal PDP. Using crop-wise data on production, MSP, and modal market prices from Agmarknet and CEDA, we estimate farmer payouts, disposal revenues, and the resulting net fiscal burden under each scenario. If procurement is limited to 40% of paddy and wheat output and 20% of other crops, total farmer payouts are estimated at ₹4.67 lakh crore (about 1.4% of GDP), with a net fiscal burden ranging from ₹28,891 to ₹52,171 crore (0.09-0.16% of GDP) after accounting for disposal revenues. A partial PDP model, retaining procurement for paddy and wheat while extending PDP to 20% of output for other crops entails broadly similar fiscal costs but offers clear efficiency gains by sharply reducing storage, handling, and logistics requirements. Moving to a universal PDP slightly increases gross expenditure but eliminates inventory-related costs altogether, simplifying administration. Based on these estimates, we recommend a hybrid MSP framework: continue physical procurement for paddy and wheat to safeguard food security, while adopting PDP for other crops. This approach balances fiscal prudence with operational efficiency and aligns India's price support system with internationally accepted best practices, while still delivering effective income support to farmers.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了印度最低支持价格（MSP）不同实施路径的财政后果，比较了三种政策选项：部分实物采购、混合方法（部分价格差额支付PDP）和普遍PDP。研究发现，采用混合框架（继续对稻米和小麦进行实物采购以确保粮食安全，同时对其他作物采用PDP）能在财政审慎和运营效率之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.research_question: 不同MSP实施路径（部分实物采购、混合PDP方法、普遍PDP）对印度2024-25营销年度的财政影响如何？哪种政策选项能在保障农民收入支持的同时实现财政可持续性和运营效率？
AI.motivation: 农民组织要求将MSP保障的实物采购从稻米和小麦扩展到所有23种MSP通知作物，但这会给财政和运营带来巨大压力。政策制定者需要基于证据的决策来平衡农民收入稳定、国家粮食安全和财政可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业价格支持政策理论、财政经济学、政策评估框架、成本效益分析、粮食安全政策理论
AI.method: 使用Agmarknet和CEDA的作物生产数据、MSP价格和模态市场价格，通过情景分析估算三种政策选项下的农民支付、处置收入和净财政负担。具体分析：1）部分实物采购（稻米和小麦40%，其他作物20%）；2）混合方法（稻米和小麦实物采购+其他作物20% PDP）；3）普遍PDP。
AI.findings: 1）部分实物采购方案：农民支付总额4.67万亿卢比（GDP的1.4%），净财政负担2889-5217亿卢比（GDP的0.09-0.16%）；2）混合PDP模型财政成本相似但运营效率显著提高，大幅减少存储、处理和物流需求；3）普遍PDP略微增加总支出但完全消除库存相关成本，简化行政管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为农业价格支持政策的财政影响提供了量化分析框架；2）比较了不同政策工具（实物采购vs价格差额支付）的效率差异；3）提出了平衡粮食安全、农民收入和财政可持续性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了具体的财政估算数据支持决策；2）推荐混合MSP框架：继续稻米和小麦实物采购保障粮食安全，其他作物采用PDP；3）使印度价格支持体系与国际最佳实践接轨，同时有效支持农民收入。

title: The Concept of Economic Guarantees of Security and Targeted Sanctions Policy

detail.title: The Concept of Economic Guarantees of Security and Targeted Sanctions Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Recent experience demonstrates that the effectiveness of sanctions policy depends less on the overall scale of economic damage and more on the precision and intensity of its impact on actual decision-makers and actors influencing decision-making processes. Broad-based sanctions frequently redistribute costs onto civilian populations, show weak correlation with changes in political behaviour, and contribute to the long-term institutional adaptation of sanctioned regimes. This preprint conceptualizes economic sanctions as a form of strategic communication and proposes a methodological shift from macroeconomic pressure to personalized and targeted interventions. Drawing on analytical tools developed in advertising and political marketing, the paper develops a typology of political regimes and corresponding sanctions-targeting strategies. It argues that increasing the effectiveness of sanctions requires identifying real centres of decision-making and tailoring instruments of influence to the specific political, economic, and industrial architecture of a regime, rather than expanding the scope of restrictions. Special attention is given to the role of credible threats of targeted sanctions as an independent deterrent factor capable of initiating internal resistance within sanctioned systems even prior to the formal imposition of restrictions. In this framework, targeted sanctions are interpreted as an integral element of a broader system of Economic Guarantees of Security, embedded within the architecture of conflict prevention and de-escalation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将经济制裁重新概念化为战略沟通工具，主张从宏观压力转向精准干预，通过识别决策中心并定制影响工具来提高制裁有效性，而非扩大限制范围。
AI.research_question: 如何提高经济制裁的有效性？特别是如何通过精准定位和个性化干预来影响实际决策者和决策过程，而非依赖大规模经济破坏？
AI.motivation: 传统广泛制裁往往将成本转嫁给平民，与政治行为改变相关性弱，且促使受制裁政权进行长期制度适应。需要更有效的制裁方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 经济制裁作为战略沟通的理论框架；2. 广告和政治营销中的分析工具；3. 政权类型学与对应制裁策略；4. 经济安全保证体系理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架开发，基于广告和政治营销工具构建政权类型学，提出针对性制裁策略的理论模型。
AI.findings: 制裁有效性取决于对实际决策中心的精准影响强度，而非总体经济破坏规模。可信的针对性制裁威胁本身就能在正式实施前引发内部抵抗。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将经济制裁重新概念化为战略沟通形式；2. 开发政权类型学与对应制裁策略框架；3. 将针对性制裁纳入经济安全保证体系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供精准制裁的方法论；2. 强调识别决策中心的重要性；3. 提出可信威胁作为独立威慑因素；4. 将制裁整合到冲突预防和降级架构中。

title: Operator-Constrained Residual Connections: A Mathematical Framework for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Operator-Constrained Residual Connections: A Mathematical Framework for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
detail.abstract: We develop a general operator-theoretic framework for stable residual mixing in deep networks, formalizing operator-constrained residual connections as a design principle in which residual interactions are restricted to non-expansive matrix manifolds to guarantee depth-independent stability of the residual mixing path and to isolate stability conditions on the nonlinear blocks. Within this framework, we prove that the Birkhoff polytope of doubly stochastic matrices constitutes the canonical convex feasible set under nonnegativity and two-sided mass preservation, with operators that (i) preserve identity mappings exactly, (ii) are closed under composition, (iii) admit efficient differentiable projections, and (iv) induce mixing dynamics without spectral amplification. This paper provides the complete mathematical foundations for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), recently introduced by Xie et al. [2026] as a stabilization of the Hyper-Connections (HC) architecture proposed by Zhu et al. [2024]. We show that the doubly stochastic constraint enforces non-expansive residual dynamics, with operator norms uniformly bounded under composition and preserved under transposition. These properties yield provable control of gradient propagation, mitigating exploding and vanishing gradients arising from residual mixing under standard Lipschitz-type assumptions on the nonlinear blocks, while preserving a large (n-1) 2-dimensional mixing family. The constraint is implemented efficiently via Sinkhorn normalization, allowing implicit differentiation and seamless integration into transformer-style architectures without altering asymptotic complexity. Beyond explaining existing architectures, our operator-constrained perspective opens a systematic design space for future residual mechanisms governed by spectral theory rather than ad-hoc normalization, establishing manifold-constrained residual mixing as a unifying framework for stable deep network design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于算子理论的稳定残差混合通用框架，将残差连接约束在非扩张矩阵流形上，以保证深度无关的稳定性并隔离非线性块的稳定性条件。证明双随机矩阵的Birkhoff多面体在非负性和双向质量保持下构成规范凸可行集，具有恒等映射保持、组合封闭、可微投影和谱无放大等特性。该框架为Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections提供了完整的数学基础，通过Sinkhorn归一化高效实现，为基于谱理论而非临时归一化的残差机制设计开辟了系统化设计空间。
AI.research_question: 如何为深度网络中的稳定残差混合建立一个通用的算子理论框架，确保深度无关的稳定性并隔离非线性块的稳定性条件？
AI.motivation: 现有残差连接设计缺乏理论保证，容易导致梯度爆炸或消失问题。需要建立一个系统化的理论框架来约束残差混合过程，确保深度网络的稳定性，同时保持足够的表达能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算子约束残差连接框架，将残差相互作用限制在非扩张矩阵流形上；Birkhoff多面体（双随机矩阵集合）作为规范凸可行集；谱理论和非扩张算子理论；流形约束残差混合的统一框架。
AI.method: 开发算子理论框架，证明双随机矩阵流形的数学性质；通过Sinkhorn归一化实现约束；分析算子范数在组合和转置下的有界性；建立梯度传播的理论控制。
AI.findings: 双随机约束强制非扩张残差动力学，算子范数在组合下一致有界且在转置下保持；在标准Lipschitz型假设下，可证明控制梯度传播，缓解梯度爆炸和消失问题；同时保持大的(n-1)^2维混合族；Sinkhorn归一化实现高效约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 为流形约束超连接提供了完整的数学基础；建立了基于谱理论的残差机制系统化设计空间；证明了双随机矩阵流形作为规范可行集的数学性质；提供了深度无关稳定性的理论保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了高效的Sinkhorn归一化约束，可无缝集成到Transformer架构中而不改变渐近复杂度；为现有架构（如Hyper-Connections）提供了稳定化方法；为未来残差机制设计提供了系统化框架。

title: Governing Artificial Intelligence in Regulated Institutions: Permissioned Governance, Accountability, and Fiduciary Duty
affiliations: Capitol Technology University

detail.title: Governing Artificial Intelligence in Regulated Institutions: Permissioned Governance, Accountability, and Fiduciary Duty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, professional, or financial interests that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work did not involve human subjects, patients, or participants, nor did it involve the collection or analysis of personal, sensitive, or identifiable data. The paper is a conceptual and policy-oriented analysis grounded in publicly available regulatory materials, standards documents, and institutional governance frameworks. No case studies involving individual persons were conducted, and no primary empirical data were collected. Accordingly, ethics committee or institutional review board approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any external funding from public, private, or nonprofit sources.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence has shifted from experimental technology to institutional force within regulated environments such as higher education and healthcare. AI systems now influence decisions affecting rights, safety, access, employment, and professional judgment, yet governance structures have not evolved to match this influence. AI is commonly introduced through procurement cycles, pilots, or vendor platforms without an explicit institutional decision that authorizes use, assigns accountability, or defines conditions for refusal. The result is governance failure rather than innovation risk: systems gain influence without permission, while responsibility remains diffuse until harm occurs.

AI.tldr: AI已从实验技术转变为高等教育和医疗等受监管环境中的制度力量，但治理结构未能跟上其影响力。AI系统通常通过采购、试点或供应商平台引入，缺乏明确的制度决策来授权使用、分配责任或定义拒绝条件，导致治理失败而非创新风险。
AI.research_question: 在受监管环境中，AI系统如何获得影响力而无需明确的制度授权，以及这种治理缺失如何导致责任分散和治理失败？
AI.motivation: AI系统现在影响权利、安全、准入、就业和专业判断等关键决策，但治理结构未能跟上其影响力，导致系统在未经明确授权的情况下获得影响力，而责任在损害发生前保持分散。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、治理理论、责任分配理论、技术采纳与扩散理论
AI.method: 概念分析、案例研究（高等教育和医疗领域）、制度分析
AI.findings: AI系统通过采购周期、试点项目或供应商平台等非正式途径进入受监管环境，缺乏明确的制度决策来授权使用、分配责任或定义拒绝条件。这导致治理失败而非创新风险：系统在未经许可的情况下获得影响力，而责任在损害发生前保持分散。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"治理失败而非创新风险"的概念框架，强调AI治理的核心问题不是技术风险，而是制度授权和责任分配的缺失。扩展了制度理论在AI治理中的应用，揭示了非正式采纳路径如何绕过正式治理结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育和医疗等受监管机构提供AI治理框架建议，强调需要明确的制度决策流程来授权AI使用、分配责任和定义拒绝条件。建议建立正式的AI采纳审批机制，防止系统在未经授权的情况下获得影响力。
